title: A Viscosity Semigroup Framework for Stable Image Reconstruction
summary: Starting from the axiomatic formulation of scale-space theory, we develop a viscosity-solution framework for multiscale image representations arising from degenerate elliptic-parabolic partial differential equations. Rather than introducing a new semigroup theory, we work within the standard viscosity-solution setting, using comparison principles to obtain well-posedness, uniqueness, and contraction in the supremum norm. This perspective is used to motivate a hybrid reconstruction operator in which a learned inverse map is followed by a nonlinear diffusion evolution. At the continuous level, the diffusion operator satisfies non-expansiveness, which provides stability for the reconstruction process; this framework is then evaluated on a CT-based mesothelioma classification task, where it attains an AUC of 0.875 with negligible variation across epochs, while the baseline model acquires AUC values from 0.49 to 0.80 without a clear convergence pattern. These observations are consistent with the stabilizing role suggested by the discussed viscosity theory.

AI.tldr: 本文基于尺度空间理论的公理化形式，建立了一个用于退化椭圆-抛物线型偏微分方程多尺度图像表示的粘性解框架。通过比较原理获得适定性和唯一性，并以此驱动一个混合重建算子（学习逆映射+非线性扩散演化）。在CT间皮瘤分类任务中，该方法取得AUC 0.875且波动极小，而基线模型AUC在0.49-0.80间剧烈波动，验证了粘性理论所预示的稳定性作用。
AI.motivation: 在图像多尺度表示中，现有基于偏微分方程的方法缺乏统一的适定性和稳定性理论框架；同时，纯数据驱动的学习方法缺乏理论保证。作者希望建立一种结合经典尺度空间理论与现代学习的混合框架，既保留PDE方法的理论严谨性（比较原理、非扩张性），又利用深度学习的能力。
AI.method: 在标准粘性解框架下（而非引入新的半群理论），利用比较原理建立退化椭圆-抛物线型PDE的适定性、唯一性和上确界范数下的压缩性。基于此构建混合重建算子：先使用学习得到的逆映射，再接一个非线性扩散演化过程。扩散算子在连续层面满足非扩张性，为重建过程提供稳定性保障。
AI.result: 在CT间皮瘤分类任务上，所提方法取得AUC为0.875，且不同训练轮次间波动极小；基线模型AUC在0.49至0.80之间波动，无清晰收敛模式。实验结果与粘性理论所预示的稳定性作用一致。
AI.conclusion: 基于粘性解框架构建的混合重建算子，通过扩散算子的非扩张性有效提升了图像重建与分类的稳定性，理论分析与实验结果吻合，验证了该框架在医学图像分析中的实用价值。
AI.abstract_zh: 从尺度空间理论的公理化形式出发，我们为源于退化椭圆-抛物线型偏微分方程的多尺度图像表示建立了一个粘性解框架。本文并非引入新的半群理论，而是在标准粘性解设定下，利用比较原理获得适定性、唯一性以及上确界范数下的压缩性。该视角被用于驱动一个混合重建算子，其中学习得到的逆映射后接一个非线性扩散演化过程。在连续层面，扩散算子满足非扩张性，为重建过程提供了稳定性；随后本文在一个基于CT的间皮瘤分类任务上对该框架进行了评估，其AUC达到0.875且各训练轮次间波动极小，而基线模型的AUC在0.49至0.80之间变化且无清晰收敛模式。这些观察结果与所讨论的粘性理论所预示的稳定性作用是一致的。

title: A Projection-Based Surrogate Gradient Interpretation for Neural Codec Wrappers
summary: Neural wrappers are learned pre-and postprocessing networks designed to enhance the performance of conventional video codecs. Although these approaches can significantly improve compression efficiency, training them remains challenging due to the non-differentiability of video codecs, which arises from the multiple discrete decisions involved in the encoding process. Surrogate gradients have recently emerged as an effective solution for enabling end-to-end learning with conventional codecs. They offer two main advantages: they avoid training an additional network to mimic the codec, and they can improve compression performance. In particular, the recently proposed SCALED method, which leverages the true compression error, has shown strong results for training neural pre-processors such as downscalers. However, this SCALED gradient was originally introduced as a reparameterization trick, which limits its interpretability. In this paper, we show that this surrogate gradient can be interpreted as a first-order local approximation of the video codec, providing insight into its effectiveness. We further demonstrate that it is effective not only for learning downscaling operations, but also for the more challenging task of full neural wrapping with pre-and post-processing networks. Finally, we show that the approach generalizes well across different video codecs, quality factors, and tasks, including multiple downscaling ratios, yielding BD-Rate (PSNR) reductions of up to -23.59% on x264 and -20.07% on VVenC relative to standard resampling baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并解释了一种用于训练视频编码神经包装器（预处理/后处理网络）的代理梯度方法，该方法将SCALED梯度重新解释为视频编解码器的一阶局部近似，并在多种编解码器和任务上取得了显著的BD-Rate降低。
AI.motivation: 传统视频编解码器的不可微性（因编码过程中的离散决策导致）使得端到端训练神经包装器非常困难，现有代理梯度方法虽有效但缺乏可解释性。
AI.method: 将SCALED代理梯度重新解释为视频编解码器的一阶局部近似，并将其扩展到完整的预处理-后处理网络（神经包装器）训练，而不仅限于下采样器。
AI.result: 在x264上实现最高-23.59%的BD-Rate(PSNR)降低，在VVenC上实现最高-20.07%的BD-Rate降低；该方法在不同编解码器、质量因子和任务（包括多倍下采样率）上均表现良好。
AI.conclusion: SCALED代理梯度可被解释为编解码器的一阶局部近似，不仅适用于下采样器训练，还能有效训练完整的神经包装器，并且具有良好的跨编解码器和任务泛化能力。
AI.abstract_zh: 神经包装器是学习得到的前处理和后处理网络，旨在提升传统视频编解码器的性能。尽管这类方法能显著提高压缩效率，但由于编码过程中涉及多个离散决策导致的视频编解码器不可微性，训练这些网络仍然充满挑战。代理梯度方法最近成为一种有效的解决方案，能够实现与传统编解码器的端到端学习。它们有两个主要优势：避免训练额外的网络来模拟编解码器，并且能够提升压缩性能。特别地，最近提出的SCALED方法利用真实的压缩误差，在训练诸如下采样器之类的神经前处理器方面展现了强大的效果。然而，该SCALED梯度最初是作为重参数化技巧被引入的，这限制了其可解释性。在本文中，我们证明该代理梯度可以被解释为视频编解码器的一阶局部近似，从而揭示了其有效性的内在机理。我们进一步证明，它不仅适用于学习下采样操作，还能有效应对更具挑战性的任务——即同时使用前处理和后处理网络的完整神经包装器。最后，我们展示了该方法在不同视频编解码器、质量因子和任务（包括多倍下采样率）上具有良好的泛化能力，与标准重采样基线相比，在x264上实现了最高-23.59%的BD-Rate(PSNR)降低，在VVenC上实现了最高-20.07%的BD-Rate降低。

title: Jury Duty: Calibration and Orientation Failures in MLLM-as-a-Judge Under Cultural Ambiguity
summary: MLLM-as-a-Judge is conventionally validated by agreement with human annotations, but this metric is undefined when the human pool is culturally heterogeneous. We introduce VOIR DIRE, a multimodal benchmark of 626 culturally paired image--prompt artifacts spanning U.S. and mainland Chinese contexts across food, fashion, and architecture, with annotator pools that are within-pool reliable (a = 0.86/0.74) but cross-pool divergent on evaluation (Q1 r = -0.12). Across six MLLMs, the bias decomposes into two failures: a positivity-floor calibration failure (compressed scale use) and an orientation failure (default to one cultural norm). On this corpus, where contested items are sampled to split the two pools, the floor mechanically validates the more-permissive Chinese reading; persona prompting partially recovers calibration, but the orientation residual survives, evidence the tilt is not reducible to scale compression. Reference-pool in-context demonstrations deepen the orientation residual and inflate the high end rather than restoring use of the low end. Model origin adds a small additive tilt (~0.10 MAE) that is approximately invariant under demonstration. We recommend reporting alignment against each reference pool separately and treating cross-pool divergence as a judge property.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VOIR DIRE基准，用于评估MLLM作为裁判在跨文化（美国vs中国）场景下的可靠性。研究发现MLLM存在两种偏差：校准失败（压缩量表使用）和定向偏差（默认某一文化规范），并证明提示工程无法完全消除文化偏差，建议对不同参考池分别报告对齐性。
AI.motivation: 传统上"MLLM-as-a-Judge"通过与人类标注的一致性来验证，但当人类标注者来自不同文化背景（文化异质性）时，这一度量标准无法定义。因此需要研究MLLM在跨文化评估中的偏差及其可校正性。
AI.method: 构建VOIR DIRE基准：包含626个文化配对的图像-提示样本，覆盖美国和中国大陆的食物、时尚、建筑三个领域，使用组内可靠（α=0.86/0.74）但组间分歧（Q1 r=-0.12）的标注者池。在6个MLLM上分解偏差为两种失效模式，并测试角色提示和参考池上下文示例等校正方法。
AI.result: 1）存在两种偏差：量表压缩导致的校准失败和默认某一文化规范的定向偏差；2）角色提示可部分恢复校准，但定向偏差依然存在；3）参考池上下文示例反而加深定向偏差并膨胀高分端；4）模型来源仅增加约0.10 MAE的小幅附加偏差，且不受示例影响。
AI.conclusion: 建议针对每个参考池分别报告对齐性，并将跨池分歧视为评判模型本身的属性，而非可简单消除的噪声。
AI.abstract_zh: 传统上，“MLLM作为评判者”通过与人类标注的一致性来验证，但当人类标注者池存在文化异质性时，这一度量指标无法定义。我们提出了VOIR DIRE，一个包含626个文化配对图像-提示样本的多模态基准，覆盖美国和中国大陆在食物、时尚和建筑三个领域的语境，其标注者池在组内可靠（α=0.86/0.74），但跨池评估存在显著分歧（Q1 r=-0.12）。在六种多模态大模型上，偏差可分解为两种失效模式：积极性下限校准失败（压缩量表使用）和定向偏差（默认采用某一文化规范）。在该语料库中，争议性样本被设计为能够分裂两个标注者池，下限机械地验证了更宽容的中文解读；角色提示可部分恢复校准，但定向偏差的残余仍然存在，证明这种倾斜不能简化为量表压缩问题。参考池上下文示例反而加深了定向偏差残余并膨胀了高分端，而非恢复低分端的使用。模型来源增加了约0.10 MAE的小幅附加偏差，且在示例条件下近似不变。我们建议针对每个参考池分别报告对齐性，并将跨池分歧视为评判模型的一种属性。

title: Beamforming and RIS-Aided Ambient Backscatter Communications with Residual-Feature SVM Detection
summary:
Ambient backscatter communication (AmBC) enables battery-free connectivity by modulating data onto existing radio-frequency (RF) signals, eliminating the need for dedicated power sources. However, its reliability degrades when direct wireless channels are obstructed or severely faded. Reconfigurable intelligent surfaces (RISs) offer a solution by creating a favorable propagation environment through the control of the phases of incident signals, thereby strengthening wireless links.
  This paper investigates an RIS-aided AmBC system that jointly exploits physical-layer reconfiguration and statistical learning to restore detection reliability under such conditions. The RIS phase profile is aligned for the source-RIS-tag link, while a multi-antenna reader applies receive beamforming to steer toward the RF source and the tag separately. At the reader, a hypothesis-based minimum mean square error (MMSE) equalizer reconstructs the ambient symbol under each candidate tag state and produces a pair of residual features, which are classified by a support vector machine (SVM) with a Gaussian kernel. We make the physical-layer-to-learning coupling explicit, i.e., RIS phase alignment and beamforming improve the signal-to-interference-plus-noise ratio (SINR), thereby rendering the residual features more separable and reducing classification error.
  Simulation results show that the proposed RIS-beamforming-SVM detector achieves substantial bit-error-rate (BER) gains over RIS-energy, SVM, and SVM-beamforming baselines across a wide SINR range, that the spectral-efficiency gains are governed more strongly by the number of RIS elements than by the number of reader antennas, and that performance saturates with a moderate RIS size, allowing near-optimal operation at reduced hardware cost.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种RIS辅助的环境反向散射通信系统，通过联合物理层重构（RIS相位对齐与波束赋形）和统计学习（MMSE均衡器+SVM分类器）来恢复遮挡或衰落信道下的检测可靠性，仿真表明该方法显著优于多种基线方案。
AI.motivation: 环境反向散射通信（AmBC）在直接无线信道被遮挡或严重衰落时可靠性严重下降，需要一种无需专用电源即可恢复检测可靠性的解决方案。
AI.method: 联合利用可重构智能表面（RIS）的相位对齐优化源-RIS-标签链路，多天线阅读器采用接收波束赋形分别指向RF源和标签，并在阅读器端使用基于假设的最小均方误差（MMSE）均衡器重建环境符号并生成残差特征，最后由高斯核支持向量机（SVM）进行分类检测。
AI.result: 1) 所提RIS-波束赋形-SVM检测器在广泛SINR范围内相比RIS能量检测、SVM和SVM-波束赋形基线获得显著BER增益；2) 频谱效率增益受RIS单元数量影响远大于阅读器天线数量；3) 性能在适中RIS规模下饱和，可在降低硬件成本下接近最优运行。
AI.conclusion: 通过物理层重构（RIS相位对齐与波束赋形）与统计学习（MMSE+SVM）的显式耦合，可有效恢复AmBC系统在恶劣信道条件下的检测可靠性，且RIS配置是实现性能增益的关键因素，在适中规模下即可达到近最优性能。
AI.abstract_zh:
环境反向散射通信（AmBC）通过在现有射频（RF）信号上调制数据实现无电池连接，无需专用电源。然而，当直接无线信道被遮挡或严重衰落时，其可靠性会下降。可重构智能表面（RIS）通过控制入射信号的相位来创建有利的传播环境，从而增强无线链路，为此提供了一种解决方案。
本文研究了一种RIS辅助的AmBC系统，该系统联合利用物理层重构和统计学习来恢复在这种条件下的检测可靠性。RIS相位配置针对源-RIS-标签链路进行对齐，而多天线阅读器分别应用接收波束赋形来指向射频源和标签。在阅读器处，基于假设的最小均方误差（MMSE）均衡器在每个候选标签状态下重建环境符号，并生成一对残差特征，这些特征由具有高斯核的支持向量机（SVM）进行分类。我们明确了物理层到学习的耦合关系，即RIS相位对齐和波束赋形提高了信号与干扰加噪声比（SINR），从而使残差特征更可分并减少了分类误差。
仿真结果表明，所提出的RIS-波束赋形-SVM检测器在广泛的SINR范围内，相比RIS能量检测、SVM和SVM-波束赋形基线实现了显著的误码率（BER）增益；频谱效率增益受RIS单元数量的影响比阅读器天线数量更大；性能在适中的RIS规模下趋于饱和，从而可以在降低硬件成本的情况下实现接近最优的运行。

title: Beyond ROC-AUC: Operating-Point Performance Reporting for Biometric Verification
summary: A biometric verifier is often deployed with a strict false match budget, so only a narrow, low false match rate (FMR) slice of the score range is used. A reporting standard for this setting already exists. ISO/IEC 19795-1 asks for error rates at stated operating points, for the detection error tradeoff (DET) curve as the view of the trade-off between FMR and the false non-match rate (FNMR), and for an interval of uncertainty on every value. In practice, a single area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (ROC-AUC), the equal error rate (EER), or a verification accuracy is still reported as the resolution, which is a threshold-independent summary that the standard does not endorse. The full ROC-AUC averages the true match rate (TMR) with equal weight over the whole FMR range from 0 to 1, so almost all of its weight is placed where the system is never operated; low-FMR behavior can then be hidden, and the order of two systems can even be reversed. The guideline is revisited in this paper and tested against seven pretrained matchers across four modalities, face, voice, iris, and fingerprint, each reported with bootstrap confidence intervals and paired bootstrap tests. A system that looks stronger on full ROC-AUC is shown to be significantly worse at FMR = 10^-3. For face, a higher full AUC was obtained by FaceNet, whereas a higher TMR at FMR = 10^-3 was obtained by ArcFace, and both gaps were significant with non-overlapping intervals. Hence, the DET curve and the FNMR at a fixed FMR are re-iterated in this paper as the primary report, with ROC-AUC and EER retained as supplementary context.

AI.tldr: 本文批评了在生物特征识别中滥用完整ROC-AUC作为性能指标的做法，指出其会掩盖低FMR区域的关键性能差异，并通过多模态实验验证了DET曲线和固定FMR下的FNMR更可靠的结论。
AI.motivation: 尽管ISO/IEC 19795-1标准已建议使用DET曲线和固定FMR下的FNMR报告性能，实践中仍广泛使用ROC-AUC和EER等阈值无关指标。这些指标在完整FMR范围上平均加权，但系统实际仅在极低FMR区域运行，导致关键性能差异被掩盖，甚至出现系统排名反转。
AI.method: 对七种预训练生物特征匹配器（涵盖人脸、语音、虹膜、指纹四种模态）进行系统评估，使用bootstrap置信区间和配对bootstrap检验，对比完整ROC-AUC与固定FMR=10^-3下的FNMR/TMR两种评估方式的差异。
AI.result: 在人脸模态中，FaceNet获得更高的完整ROC-AUC，但ArcFace在FMR=10^-3下获得更高的TMR，两种差距均显著且置信区间无重叠。这表明完整ROC-AUC表现强的系统在低FMR操作区域可能显著更差。
AI.conclusion: 应坚持ISO/IEC标准，以DET曲线和固定FMR下的FNMR作为主要报告指标，ROC-AUC和EER仅作为补充参考。
AI.abstract_zh: 生物特征验证器通常部署在严格的误匹配预算下，因此仅使用分数范围中狭窄的、低误匹配率（FMR）切片。针对该场景已有报告标准。ISO/IEC 19795-1要求报告在指定操作点上的错误率、将检测错误权衡（DET）曲线作为FMR与误非匹配率（FNMR）之间权衡的视图，以及每个值的置信区间。然而在实践中，接收者操作特征曲线下面积（ROC-AUC）、等错误率（EER）或验证准确率仍被作为分辨率指标报告，这些是标准不认可的阈值无关汇总指标。完整的ROC-AUC在从0到1的整个FMR范围内等权平均真匹配率（TMR），因此其绝大部分权重分布在系统从未部署的区域；低FMR行为可能被掩盖，甚至两个系统的排序可能发生反转。本文重新审视了这一指南，并在四种模态（人脸、语音、虹膜和指纹）上对七个预训练匹配器进行测试，每个结果均附带了bootstrap置信区间和配对bootstrap检验。结果显示，在完整ROC-AUC上表现更强的系统在FMR=10^-3时显著更差。对于人脸，FaceNet获得了更高的完整AUC，而ArcFace在FMR=10^-3时获得了更高的TMR，两种差距均显著且区间无重叠。因此，本文重申DET曲线和固定FMR下的FNMR应作为主要报告指标，ROC-AUC和EER仅保留作为补充参考。

title: Velocity Information Geometry of Coherent Intra-CPI Waveform Agility
summary: Spectrum sharing forces radars to vary carrier frequency and bandwidth on a pulse-to-pulse basis within a coherent processing interval (CPI). While the resulting range-Doppler distortion is well-studied, the corresponding velocity estimation limit is not. We show that in the resolved-bin slow-time model of coherent agile-CPI processing, the effective Fisher information for radial velocity is the SNR-weighted energy of the carrier-time lever arm that survives projection out of the range and phase nuisance subspace. The carrier sequence thus sets the projection geometry, while the bandwidth sequence enters only through SNR weighting. Two consequences follow. First, the carrier sequence inflates the bound by a closed-form factor governed by the correlation between carrier offset and slow time: randomized or orthogonalized hops are nearly harmless, while ramp-correlated hops can severely degrade velocity information. Second, under matched filtering at equal pulse energy, the velocity Cramer-Rao bound (CRB) is invariant to the bandwidth sequence; a corollary recasts the output-SNR loss of agile-CPI mismatched filtering as a processing cost entering only through a per-pulse mismatch loss. The bound is verified against a brute-force Fisher matrix and Monte-Carlo maximum-likelihood estimation. The result yields a design principle: carrier hopping should be chosen not only for spectral coexistence but also to preserve the velocity-information residual.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了认知雷达在相干处理间隔内跳频/跳带宽对径向速度估计极限的影响，推导了克拉美-罗下界（CRB）的闭合形式，发现载频序列对速度信息影响显著而带宽序列无影响，并提出了保护速度信息残差的载频跳变设计原则。
AI.motivation: 频谱共享迫使雷达在相干处理间隔内脉冲间跳变载频和带宽，由此产生的距离-多普勒失真已有充分研究，但对应的速度估计极限尚不明确。本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 在解析bin的慢时间模型中推导速度估计的Fisher信息矩阵和CRB，分析载频序列和带宽序列对速度信息的影响，通过蒙特卡洛最大似然估计和暴力Fisher矩阵验证理论结果。
AI.result: 1）有效的Fisher信息为载波-时间杠杆臂经距离和相位干扰子空间投影后的SNR加权能量；2）载频序列通过相关性因子影响CRB：随机化/正交化跳变几乎无害，斜坡相关跳变严重恶化速度信息；3）等脉冲能量匹配滤波下，速度CRB对带宽序列不变；4）失配滤波的输出SNR损失仅表现为逐脉冲失配损失。
AI.conclusion: 载波跳变的选择不仅要考虑频谱共存，还应保护速度信息残差，即应选择随机化或正交化的载频跳变模式而非斜坡相关模式。
AI.abstract_zh: 频谱共享迫使雷达在相干处理间隔内逐脉冲跳变载频和带宽。虽然由此产生的距离-多普勒失真已有充分研究，但相应的速度估计极限尚不明确。我们证明，在相干捷变CPI处理的解析bin慢时间模型中，径向速度的有效Fisher信息是载波-时间杠杆臂经距离和相位干扰子空间投影后残存的SNR加权能量。因此，载频序列决定了投影几何，而带宽序列仅通过SNR加权产生影响。由此产生两个结论：第一，载频序列由一个闭合因子放大下界，该因子由载波偏移与慢时间之间的相关性决定：随机化或正交化的跳变几乎无害，而斜坡相关的跳变会严重恶化速度信息。第二，在等脉冲能量匹配滤波条件下，速度的克拉美-罗下界对带宽序列保持不变；一个推论将捷变CPI失配滤波的输出SNR损失重新解释为仅通过逐脉冲失配损失体现的处理代价。该下界通过暴力Fisher矩阵和蒙特卡洛最大似然估计得到验证。结果得出一个设计原则：载波跳变的选择不仅应考虑频谱共存，还应保护速度信息残差。

title: Relational Gaze Transitions During Encoding Predict Episodic Recall of Naturalistic Scenes
summary: Remembering a visual scene requires organizing distinct details into a cohesive event. This study investigates whether relation-guided gaze transitions provide a behavioural marker of this cognitive organization during episodic encoding and retrieval. By applying scene graph annotations to eye-tracking data, we measured whether gaze moved between objects that were meaningfully related within complex scenes. This approach allowed us to quantify relational scanning within naturalistic environments, moving beyond prior methods that relied on simplified displays or isolated relation types. Participants showed above-chance relational gaze during both initial viewing and blank-screen retrieval, indicating that gaze actively tracks scene structure during first viewing and at recall. Additionally, relational scanning at encoding predicted subsequent free recall of both object and relational details, even after accounting for salience, fixation frequency, meaning, and image-level differences. In contrast, relational scanning at retrieval did not predict recall success, suggesting that relational gaze is most functional to memory during its formation. Together, these findings show that relational gaze can be measured in complex scenes and may serve as a marker of episodic encoding during natural visual exploration.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用场景图注释分析眼动数据，发现关系引导的注视转移（关系扫描）是情景记忆编码的行为标记：编码时的关系扫描预测了后续的自由回忆表现，而提取时的扫描则无此效应。
AI.motivation: 现有研究多采用简化刺激或孤立关系类型，缺乏在自然复杂场景中量化关系引导注视转移的方法，无法直接测量记忆编码和提取过程中视觉组织的行为标记。
AI.method: 对复杂场景图像进行场景图注释（标注对象间有意义的关系），结合眼动追踪技术，测量被试在初始观看和空白屏提取期间，注视是否在场景图中存在语义关系的对象之间转移，从而量化关系扫描行为。
AI.result: 1) 在初始观看和空白屏提取阶段，被试的关系扫描均显著高于随机水平；2) 编码时的关系扫描能够显著预测后续对物体及其关系的自由回忆表现，且该效应独立于显著性、注视频率、语义意义和图像级差异；3) 提取时的关系扫描无法预测回忆成功。
AI.conclusion: 关系扫描可在复杂自然场景中可靠测量，并作为情景记忆编码的行为标记，表明自然视觉探索中的注视行为反映着记忆形成过程中的认知组织。
AI.abstract_zh: 回忆一个视觉场景需要将不同的细节组织成一个连贯的事件。本研究探究了关系引导的注视转移是否可作为情景编码和提取过程中这种认知组织的行为标记。通过将场景图标注应用于眼动数据，我们测量了注视是否在复杂场景内具有语义关联的对象之间移动。这种方法使我们能够在自然环境下量化关系扫描，超越了先前依赖于简化刺激或孤立关系类型的方法。在初始观看阶段和空白屏提取阶段，被试均表现出高于随机水平的关系扫描，表明注视在首次观看和回忆时都主动追踪了场景结构。此外，编码阶段的关系扫描能够预测后续对物体及其关系细节的自由回忆表现，即使在控制了显著性、注视频率、语义意义和图像级别差异之后仍然显著。相比之下，提取阶段的关系扫描则不能预测回忆成功，表明关系注视在记忆形成过程中最具功能性。综合而言，这些发现表明关系扫描可在复杂场景中测量，并可能作为自然视觉探索中情景编码的标记。

title: Towards CSI-Native Foundation Models: A Channel-Adaptive Roadmap for 6G
comment: 7 pages, 5 figures, submmited to IEEE WCM
summary: Wireless foundation models offer a path toward reusable channel state information (CSI) intelligence for sixth-generation (6G) systems. However, existing generic-backbone adaptation and CSI pretraining methods often treat CSI as task tensors rather than propagation-conditioned channel responses, thereby failing to capture the intrinsic time-frequency-spatial geometry of wireless environments. This paper presents a channel-adaptive roadmap toward CSI-native foundation models, proposing a unified framework that aligns pretraining, positional modeling, and attention control with three channel requirements: scale-aware heterogeneous exposure, physical time-frequency-antenna coordinates, and correlation-bounded token interaction. Extensive experiments demonstrate the superiority of the proposed framework across three dimensions: zero-shot generalization, reducing NMSE by more than 4 dB across spatial-temporal-frequency tasks; scale extrapolation, yielding up to a 5.4 dB gain under 8 times unseen antenna scaling; and inference efficiency, accelerating mobility-aware processing by up to 18.8%. A system-level evaluation with Sionna SYS further shows that the proposed framework uses only 7.01% of dense-pilot overhead, reaches -18.64 dB average NMSE, and improves average net spectral efficiency by 36.6% over dense LMMSE and 15.5% over WiFo, indicating that CSI-native representation learning can support pilot-efficient radio access.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种面向CSI原生基础模型的信道自适应框架，通过统一预训练、位置建模和注意力控制与三大信道需求对齐，在零样本泛化、尺度外推和推理效率上显著优于现有方法，并以极低导频开销实现高性能无线接入。
AI.motivation: 现有无线基础模型将CSI视为任务张量而非传播条件信道响应，未能捕获无线环境内在的时频空几何结构，导致模型缺乏信道自适应性。
AI.method: 提出一个统一框架，将预训练、位置建模和注意力控制与三个信道需求对齐：尺度感知的异构暴露、物理时频天线坐标、以及相关性约束的令牌交互。
AI.result: 零样本泛化：NMSE降低超过4 dB；尺度外推：8倍未见天线缩放下增益达5.4 dB；推理效率：移动感知处理加速达18.8%；系统评估：仅用7.01%密集导频开销，平均NMSE达-18.64 dB，净频谱效率比LMMSE提升36.6%、比WiFo提升15.5%。
AI.conclusion: CSI原生表示学习能够支持导频高效的无线接入，为6G系统的信道智能复用提供了有效路径。
AI.abstract_zh: 无线基础模型为第六代（6G）系统提供了一条可复用信道状态信息（CSI）智能的路径。然而，现有的通用骨干自适应和CSI预训练方法通常将CSI视为任务张量而非传播条件信道响应，从而未能捕获无线环境内在的时频空几何结构。本文提出了一条面向CSI原生基础模型的信道自适应路线图，构建了一个统一框架，将预训练、位置建模和注意力控制与三个信道需求对齐：尺度感知的异构暴露、物理时频天线坐标以及相关性约束的令牌交互。大量实验表明，所提框架在三个维度上具有优越性：零样本泛化，在时空频任务上NMSE降低超过4 dB；尺度外推，在8倍未见天线缩放下产生高达5.4 dB的增益；推理效率，移动感知处理加速达18.8%。基于Sionna SYS的系统级评估进一步表明，所提框架仅使用7.01%的密集导频开销，达到-18.64 dB的平均NMSE，相比密集LMMSE和WiFo，平均净频谱效率分别提升了36.6%和15.5%，表明CSI原生表示学习能够支持导频高效的无线接入。

title: From Sparse X-rays to 3D CT: Training-Free Reconstruction with Diffusion Priors
summary: Solving 3D medical inverse problems typically requires training dedicated supervised models for each specific task and measurement setting. To break this dependency, we present TF-PRDiT: a training-free conditional sampling framework that converts a frozen voxel-level 3D Diffusion Transformer prior into a versatile inverse medical problem solver. Building on the posterior-sampling view of diffusion inverse solvers, TF-PRDiT enforces measurement consistency during sampling via a task-specific forward operator rather than updating model weights, enabling a single pretrained prior to be reused across diverse conditional settings. Our method combines a predictor-corrector sampler with likelihood-based guidance on the denoised prediction, providing stable data-fidelity correction while preserving the underlying 3D anatomical prior. We highlight our framework's capability on the challenging task of X-ray-to-CT reconstruction by integrating a differentiable DRR projector to allow gradients to propagate directly from projection space back to voxels without any retraining. Experiments on LIDC-IDRI demonstrate that TF-PRDiT achieves strong reconstruction quality and uniquely scales to an arbitrary number of input X-rays (1-12) under a unified model, with performance improving consistently as additional views are provided. Beyond X-ray-to-CT, we show that simply swapping the forward operator extends the same frozen model to 3D super-resolution, volumetric infilling, and deblurring without any task-specific retraining, demonstrating that a single 3D diffusion prior can serve as a universal solver for volumetric medical inverse problems.

AI.tldr: TF-PRDiT提出了一种无需训练的3D条件采样框架，利用冻结的扩散Transformer先验，通过任务特定的前向算子在采样过程中强制执行测量一致性，从而将单一预训练模型复用为多种3D医学逆问题的通用求解器，无需任何任务特定的重新训练。
AI.motivation: 传统3D医学逆问题求解需要为每个任务和测量设置分别训练专用的监督模型，缺乏通用性和可复用性。本文旨在打破这种依赖关系，探索能否利用单一预训练的3D扩散先验，无需重新训练即可解决多种逆问题。
AI.method: TF-PRDiT基于后验采样的扩散逆求解器视角，在采样过程中通过任务特定的前向算子（而非更新模型权重）强制执行测量一致性。方法结合了预测-校正采样器与基于似然引导的去噪预测，在保持底层3D解剖先验的同时提供稳定的数据保真度校正。在X射线到CT重建任务中，集成了可微分的DRR投影器，使梯度直接从投影空间传播回体素空间。
AI.result: 在LIDC-IDRI数据集上的实验表明，TF-PRDiT在X射线到CT重建中取得了高质量重建结果，且能在统一模型下扩展到任意数量的输入X射线（1-12张），性能随视角增加持续提升。此外，仅需更换前向算子，同一冻结模型即可扩展到3D超分辨率、体积填充和去模糊任务，无需任何任务特定重新训练。
AI.conclusion: 单一3D扩散先验可以作为体积医学逆问题的通用求解器，TF-PRDiT框架证明了无需重新训练即可跨多种任务复用预训练模型的有效性，为医学影像逆问题求解提供了一种灵活、通用的范式。
AI.abstract_zh: 解决3D医学逆问题通常需要为每个特定任务和测量设置训练专用的监督模型。为打破这种依赖关系，我们提出TF-PRDiT：一种无需训练的条件采样框架，将冻结的体素级3D扩散Transformer先验转化为通用的逆医学问题求解器。基于扩散逆求解器的后验采样视角，TF-PRDiT在采样过程中通过任务特定的前向算子强制执行测量一致性，而非更新模型权重，从而使得单个预训练先验可以在多种条件设置下重复使用。我们的方法将预测-校正采样器与基于似然引导的去噪预测相结合，在保持底层3D解剖先验的同时提供稳定的数据保真度校正。我们通过在X射线到CT重建这一挑战性任务上展示该框架的能力，集成了可微分的DRR投影器，使梯度能够直接从投影空间传播回体素空间，无需任何重新训练。在LIDC-IDRI数据集上的实验表明，TF-PRDiT实现了高质量的重建结果，并且能够在统一模型下扩展到任意数量的输入X射线（1-12张），随着视图数量的增加性能持续提升。除了X射线到CT重建外，我们展示只需更换前向算子，同一个冻结模型即可扩展到3D超分辨率、体积填充和去模糊任务，无需任何任务特定的重新训练，证明单一3D扩散先验可以作为体积医学逆问题的通用求解器。

title: A UAV-Based Multi-Modal Vision System for Automated Sideslope Deformation Monitoring and Hazard Detection
summary: Slope hazards constitute a major safety threat to expressway infrastructure, and their evolution is typically manifested as slow surface deformation. Conventional manual inspection suffers from low efficiency and inadequate operational safety, especially on severely deteriorated slopes. Accordingly, there is an urgent need for an automated, high-precision solution capable of large-area slope observation and analysis. This study aims to develop a highly automated workflow for slope hazard detection using Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV)-borne Light Detection and Ranging (LiDAR). The proposed workflow consists of a shared data-acquisition and ground-surface extraction stage, a single-observation hazard-screening branch based on RandLA-Net, and a multi-epoch deformation-monitoring branch based on grid-wise elevation differencing. To validate the effectiveness of the proposed system, we conducted multiple UAV-borne LiDAR data-acquisition flights in real expressway slope environments. The results show that the workflow can extract usable ground-surface point clouds under vegetation cover, identify potential hazard zones from single-observation point clouds, and quantify centimeter-level elevation changes using multi-epoch grid differencing. This study establishes an end-to-end UAV-borne LiDAR-based workflow for slope inspection and demonstrates its feasibility through controlled experiments, field tests, and simulation-based validation, thereby providing an implementable solution for automated slope-hazard monitoring and intelligent early warning.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一种基于无人机载LiDAR的自动化边坡灾害检测工作流，包含数据采集与地面提取、基于RandLA-Net的单次灾害筛查以及多期网格高程差分变形监测，在真实高速公路边坡环境中验证了其提取植被覆盖下地面点云、识别潜在灾害区及量化厘米级高程变化的能力，为边坡自动化监测与智能预警提供了可实施方案。
AI.motivation: 传统人工巡检高速公路边坡灾害效率低、安全性差，尤其是严重退化的边坡，亟需一种自动化、高精度的大面积边坡观测与分析解决方案。
AI.method: 提出一种高度自动化的无人机载LiDAR边坡灾害检测工作流，包含三个核心阶段：(1) 共享的数据采集与地面点云提取阶段；(2) 基于RandLA-Net的单次观测灾害筛查分支；(3) 基于网格高程差分的多期变形监测分支。
AI.result: 在真实高速公路边坡环境中，该工作流能够提取植被覆盖下的可用地面点云，从单次观测点云中识别潜在灾害区域，并通过多期网格差分量化厘米级高程变化。
AI.conclusion: 本研究建立了一套端到端的无人机载LiDAR边坡检测工作流，通过控制实验、现场测试和仿真验证证明了其可行性，为自动化边坡灾害监测与智能预警提供了可实施的解决方案。
AI.abstract_zh: 边坡灾害对高速公路基础设施构成重大安全威胁，其演化通常表现为缓慢的地表变形。传统人工巡检效率低、作业安全性不足，尤其在严重退化的边坡上这一问题更为突出。因此，亟需一种能够实现大面积边坡观测与分析的自动化、高精度解决方案。本研究旨在开发一种基于无人机载激光雷达（LiDAR）的高度自动化边坡灾害检测工作流。所提出的工作流包含一个共享的数据采集与地表提取阶段、一个基于RandLA-Net的单次观测灾害筛查分支，以及一个基于网格高程差分的多期变形监测分支。为验证所提系统的有效性，我们在真实高速公路边坡环境中开展了多次无人机载LiDAR数据采集飞行。结果表明，该工作流能够提取植被覆盖下的可用地面点云，从单次观测点云中识别潜在灾害区域，并通过多期网格差分量化厘米级高程变化。本研究建立了一套端到端的无人机载LiDAR边坡检测工作流，并通过控制实验、现场测试和仿真验证证明了其可行性，从而为自动化边坡灾害监测与智能预警提供了可实施的解决方案。

title: Asynchronous Multi-Channel USF: Modified CRT for Modulo Unfolding
comment: To appear in the proceedings of 2026 European Signal Processing Conference (EUSIPCO)
summary: The Unlimited Sampling Framework (USF) overcomes the traditional trade-off between dynamic range and digital resolution, achieving performance unattainable with standard ADCs. Its multi-channel extension (MC-USF) enables reconstruction from multiple folded measurements at critical sampling rates. Existing MC-USF methods typically rely on Chinese Remainder Theorem (CRT)-based unfolding, which requires strict channel-level sampling synchronization and is therefore vulnerable to timing mismatch, jitter, and drift. This paper introduces an asynchronous MC-USF architecture that eliminates the need for synchronization. By viewing spatial-temporal signal lifting as inducing smoothness over a graph of sensing channels, we develop a reconstruction strategy robust to temporal misalignment. Numerical experiments validate the approach, demonstrating accurate recovery and enabling more practical multi-channel USF implementations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种异步多通道无限制采样框架（MC-USF），通过将时空信号提升视为在传感通道图上引入平滑性，消除了传统方法对通道级采样同步的严格要求，实现了对时间错位鲁棒的重建。
AI.motivation: 现有的MC-USF方法通常依赖基于中国剩余定理（CRT）的解折叠技术，这要求严格的通道级采样同步，因而对时间失配、抖动和漂移非常敏感，限制了实际应用。
AI.method: 提出一种异步MC-USF架构，通过将时空信号提升建模为在传感通道图上诱导平滑性，构建对时间错位具有鲁棒性的重建策略，从而无需同步机制。
AI.result: 数值实验验证了该方法能够实现准确的重建恢复，使得多通道USF的实际部署更加可行。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的异步架构有效解决了多通道无限制采样中的同步瓶颈问题，为更实用的多通道USF实现提供了可行方案。
AI.abstract_zh: 无限制采样框架（USF）克服了动态范围与数字分辨率之间的传统权衡，实现了标准模数转换器无法达到的性能。其多通道扩展（MC-USF）能够在临界采样率下从多个折叠测量值中实现重建。现有的MC-USF方法通常依赖基于中国剩余定理（CRT）的解折叠技术，这要求严格的通道级采样同步，因而对时间失配、抖动和漂移非常敏感。本文提出了一种异步MC-USF架构，消除了对同步机制的需求。通过将时空信号提升视为在传感通道图上诱导平滑性，我们构建了对时间错位具有鲁棒性的重建策略。数值实验验证了该方法的有效性，展示了准确的恢复能力，并使更实用的多通道USF实现成为可能。

title: Adaptive conduction delays and phase locking in spiking Haken Lighthouse networks
summary: We develop a theory of phase-locked activity in delayed spiking networks using the Haken Lighthouse model as an analytically tractable event-based description of neural dynamics. For networks with fixed delays, we derive self-consistency conditions for phase-locked states and an associated linear stability theory formulated directly in terms of spike-time perturbations. The framework is illustrated for a delayed autapse, a reciprocally coupled two-cell network, and spatially structured rings with distance-dependent coupling and conduction delays, where circulant symmetry allows stability to be decomposed into Fourier modes. We then introduce an activity-dependent white matter plasticity rule in which myelination modulates axonal conduction speed and hence communication delay. This leads naturally to a slow--fast system with state-dependent delays, in which frozen phase-locked branches organise the adaptive dynamics. The plasticity rule selects commensurate delay--period relationships, providing a mechanism for the emergence of synchrony, other frequency-locked states, slow switching between competing phase-locked patterns, and the organisation of heterogeneous delays into discrete delay--period classes. Direct simulations of the event-driven network support the analytical predictions and illustrate how adaptive conduction can reshape the attractor structure of a delayed spiking network and generate long-timescale transitions. These results provide a tractable mathematical framework for studying how activity-dependent myelination may regulate temporal coordination, synchrony, and communication through coherence in spiking neural systems.

AI.tldr: 本文利用Haken Lighthouse模型作为可解析的事件驱动神经动力学框架，发展了延迟尖峰网络中锁相活动的理论，包括自洽条件、线性稳定性分析，并引入活动依赖的白质可塑性规则（髓鞘调节轴突传导速度进而改变通信延迟），揭示了自适应延迟如何重塑吸引子结构并产生长时间尺度转换，为理解活动依赖髓鞘化调控神经同步与时间协调提供了数学基础。
AI.motivation: 为延迟尖峰网络中的锁相活动建立可解析的数学理论，并研究活动依赖的白质可塑性（髓鞘化调节传导延迟）如何影响神经回路的时间协调、同步以及“通过相干性通信”机制。
AI.method: 基于Haken Lighthouse模型（事件驱动的尖峰网络描述），推导固定延迟下锁相态的自洽条件和尖峰时间扰动的线性稳定性理论；引入活动依赖的髓鞘可塑性规则（传导速度随活动变化），构建状态依赖延迟的慢-快系统，通过冻结锁相分支分析自适应动力学。
AI.result: 推导了延迟自突触、双向耦合双细胞网络以及具有距离依赖耦合和传导延迟的空间环状网络的锁相稳定性；发现活动依赖的髓鞘可塑性规则选择共生的延迟-周期关系，导致同步、频率锁定、锁相模式间的慢速切换以及异质延迟组织为离散延迟-周期类别；事件驱动模拟验证了解析预测。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了一个易处理的数学框架，用于研究活动依赖髓鞘化如何调控尖峰神经系统中的时间协调、同步和通过相干性通信，揭示了自适应传导延迟可以重塑延迟尖峰网络的吸引子结构并生成长时间尺度动态转换。
AI.abstract_zh: 我们利用Haken Lighthouse模型作为神经动力学的事件驱动可解析描述，发展了延迟尖峰网络中锁相活动的理论。对于具有固定延迟的网络，我们推导了锁相态的自洽条件以及直接以尖峰时间扰动形式表述的线性稳定性理论。该框架在延迟自突触、双向耦合双细胞网络以及具有距离依赖耦合和传导延迟的空间环状结构网络中得到验证，其中循环对称性允许将稳定性分解为傅里叶模式。随后，我们引入一种活动依赖的白质可塑性规则，其中髓鞘化调节轴突传导速度，从而改变通信延迟。这自然地导出了一个具有状态依赖延迟的慢-快系统，其中冻结的锁相分支组织自适应动力学。该可塑性规则选择共生的延迟-周期关系，为同步、其他频率锁定状态、竞争性锁相模式之间的慢速切换以及异质延迟组织为离散延迟-周期类别提供了机制。事件驱动网络的直接模拟支持解析预测，并展示了自适应传导如何重塑延迟尖峰网络的吸引子结构以及生成长时间尺度的转换。这些结果提供了一个易处理的数学框架，用于研究活动依赖的髓鞘化如何调控尖峰神经系统中的时间协调、同步以及通过相干性通信。

title: NeuroShield: A Device-Agnostic Foundation Model for EEG Authentication
summary: A central challenge in EEG authentication is that models are typically tied to the acquisition settings in which they are trained. In particular, variations in headset hardware, channel layout, and signal duration create heterogeneous recordings that existing models are not designed to handle, causing each new headset or dataset to be treated as a separate model-development problem. This fragmentation limits multi-dataset learning, hinders knowledge transfer, and reduces model reusability. To address this limitation, we present NeuroShield, a reusable foundation model for EEG authentication that learns identity-discriminative embeddings from variable-channel and variable-length EEG recordings through a dual-stage transformer architecture. We pretrain NeuroShield on three public EEG datasets comprising 15{,}762 subjects and 28{,}116 sessions, and evaluate transfer on two unseen downstream datasets. Our evaluations show that, after fine-tuning, NeuroShield reduces equal error rate by 0.44--8.06 percentage points relative to the state of the art. NeuroShield further generalizes to segments longer than those seen during training and operates across channel layouts not encountered during pretraining. These results establish NeuroShield as a reusable and adaptable EEG identity encoder across heterogeneous recording settings. We release NeuroShield as open source to support reproducibility and community adoption.

AI.tldr: NeuroShield 是一个可重用的 EEG 身份认证基础模型，通过双阶段 Transformer 架构处理可变通道和可变长度的 EEG 信号，在多个数据集上预训练后能有效迁移到未见过的下游数据集，显著降低等错误率。
AI.motivation: 现有 EEG 身份认证模型严重依赖特定的采集设置（如头戴设备、通道布局、信号时长），不同数据集被视为独立的模型开发问题，导致碎片化严重、知识迁移困难、模型复用性差。亟需一个能跨异构设置泛化的统一 EEG 身份编码模型。
AI.method: 提出 NeuroShield，采用双阶段 Transformer 架构，从可变通道和可变长度的 EEG 记录中学习具有身份判别力的嵌入表示。在三个公开 EEG 数据集（共 15,762 名被试、28,116 个会话）上预训练，并在两个未见过的下游数据集上评估迁移性能。
AI.result: 微调后，NeuroShield 相比现有最优方法将等错误率（EER）降低了 0.44–8.06 个百分点；能泛化到训练时未见过的更长 EEG 片段；能处理预训练中未遇到的通道布局。
AI.conclusion: NeuroShield 被证明是一个可重用且适应性强的 EEG 身份编码器，可在异构记录设置下工作，并开源以支持可重复性和社区应用。
AI.abstract_zh: EEG身份认证的一个核心挑战在于，模型通常与其训练时的采集设置紧密绑定。特别是，头戴设备硬件、通道布局和信号时长的差异会造成异构的记录，而现有模型无法处理这些差异，导致每种新设备或新数据集都被视为独立的模型开发问题。这种碎片化限制了多数据集学习、阻碍了知识迁移、降低了模型的可重用性。为解决这一局限，我们提出了 NeuroShield，一个可重用的 EEG 身份认证基础模型，它通过双阶段 Transformer 架构从可变通道和可变长度的 EEG 记录中学习具有身份判别力的嵌入表示。我们在三个公开 EEG 数据集（共计 15,762 名被试和 28,116 个会话）上预训练 NeuroShield，并在两个未见过的下游数据集上评估其迁移性能。评估结果表明，微调后 NeuroShield 相比现有最优方法将等错误率降低了 0.44–8.06 个百分点。NeuroShield 还能泛化到训练时未见过的更长片段，并能在预训练中未遇到的通道布局上运行。这些结果确立了 NeuroShield 作为一个可重用且适应性强的 EEG 身份编码器，适用于异构记录设置。我们将 NeuroShield 开源，以支持可重复性和社区应用。

title: Dataset-Aware Cold-Start Active Learning for Annotation-Efficient 3D Medical Image Segmentation
comment: 20 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables. Supplementary material available as ancillary file
summary: Deep learning for 3D medical image segmentation requires extensive manual annotations, a major bottleneck in volumetric medical imaging. Active learning aims to reduce this burden by selecting informative samples for annotation, but most methods assume that an initial labeled set is already available. This leaves the cold-start problem largely unresolved: how to select the first volumes from a fully unlabeled pool before any task-specific model is trained. We propose CSCS, a Curriculum-Stratified Cold-Start framework that adapts initial sample selection to the structure of the unlabeled dataset. CSCS combines two self-supervised, label-free signals: local typicality, measuring representativeness in the embedding space, and reconstruction-based uncertainty, used as a proxy for sample difficulty. These signals are combined through a weighted geometric score, where the weighting is determined by a closed-form pacing rule based on the effective annotation budget and the Difficulty-Coverage Ratio, a pool-level statistic measuring the alignment between difficulty and representativeness. We evaluate CSCS on four 3D medical image segmentation benchmarks: BraTS, FeTA, Spleen, and an in-house fetal MRI dataset. Using nnU-Net as downstream segmentation model, CSCS shows consistently competitive performance across datasets and annotation budgets, with the strongest gains in low-to-mid annotation regimes. These results suggest that dataset-aware cold-start initialization can improve the robustness of active learning for 3D medical image segmentation by adapting sample selection to the geometry of the unlabeled pool.

AI.tldr: 提出CSCS框架，通过结合局部典型性和重建不确定性，解决3D医学图像分割中主动学习的冷启动问题，无需初始标注即可选择有价值的样本。
AI.motivation: 3D医学图像分割依赖大量人工标注，主动学习虽能减少标注负担，但大多数方法假设已存在初始标注集，冷启动问题（在无标注池中如何选择第一批样本）尚未得到有效解决。
AI.method: 提出CSCS（Curriculum-Stratified Cold-Start）框架，结合两种自监督、无标签信号：局部典型性（衡量嵌入空间中的代表性）和重建不确定性（样本难度的代理）。通过加权几何分数合并二者，权重由基于有效标注预算和难度-覆盖率比率的闭式调节规则确定。
AI.result: 在BraTS、FeTA、Spleen和内部胎儿MRI四个3D医学图像分割基准上，以nnU-Net为下游模型，CSCS在所有数据集和标注预算下表现一致且竞争力强，在低到中标注区间增益最显著。
AI.conclusion: 数据集感知的冷启动初始化通过自适应样本选择适应未标注池的数据几何结构，可以提升3D医学图像分割中主动学习的鲁棒性。
AI.abstract_zh: 三维医学图像分割的深度学习需要大量人工标注，这是体积医学成像的主要瓶颈。主动学习旨在通过选择信息量大的样本来减少标注负担，但大多数方法假设初始标注集已经存在。这导致冷启动问题在很大程度上仍未解决：在训练任何任务特定模型之前，如何从一个完全未标注的池中选择第一批体积？我们提出CSCS，一个课程分层冷启动框架，该框架将初始样本选择适应于未标注数据集的结构。CSCS结合了两种自监督、无标签信号：局部典型性（衡量嵌入空间中的代表性）和基于重建的不确定性（用作样本难度的代理）。这些信号通过加权几何分数合并，其中权重由基于有效标注预算和难度-覆盖率比率的闭式调节规则确定，难度-覆盖率比率是一个衡量难度与代表性之间对齐程度的池级统计量。我们在四个三维医学图像分割基准上评估CSCS：BraTS、FeTA、Spleen和一个内部胎儿MRI数据集。使用nnU-Net作为下游分割模型，CSCS在所有数据集和标注预算下均表现出持续具有竞争力的性能，在低到中标注区间增益最强。这些结果表明，数据集感知的冷启动初始化可以通过将样本选择适应于未标注池的几何结构，提高三维医学图像分割中主动学习的鲁棒性。

title: Open Annotations and Synthetic Data for Field Localisation in Indian Bank Cheques
summary:
Automated cheque processing requires localising key fields (date, legal amount, IFSC code, account number, signature, and payee name)
  before any recognition step. The IDRBT Cheque Image Dataset is, to our knowledge, the only public collection of Indian bank cheques, but it
  ships without field annotations and with no stated licence, so its redistribution terms are unclear. We address both limitations. First,
  we release six-field bounding-box annotations for all 112 cheques in the dataset, distributed annotations-only and keyed to the original
  filenames so that the IDRBT redistribution terms are respected. Second, we release 295 fully redistributable synthetic cheque images
  produced by a cut-paste pipeline that composites annotated field regions from real cheques onto content-erased, bank-specific canvas
  templates; because patches are pasted at their source coordinates, annotations carry forward unchanged. Third, we provide a ResNet-50
  direct-regression baseline that predicts all six fields in a single forward pass, and use it for a controlled test of the synthetic data.
  The test is sobering: because cheque layouts are rigid, a no-learning baseline that simply predicts each field's mean training box already
  reaches 0.691 mean IoU and 80% accuracy at IoU >= 0.5, and once seed variance and training compute are accounted for, the cut-paste
  synthetic data yields no measurable improvement over real data alone (an equal-compute real-only model matches or beats the
  synthetic-augmented model on every aggregate metric). We report this negative result in full, since it cautions against assuming
  appearance-only augmentation helps fixed-layout documents and points instead to layout-varying synthesis. The annotations and synthetic
  images are released as reusable resources on the Hugging Face Hub under permissive licences.

AI.tldr: 本文针对IDRBT支票图像数据集缺少标注和许可证不明确的问题，发布了112张真实支票的六字段边界框标注和295张完全可再分发的合成支票图像，并提供了一个ResNet-50直接回归基线模型。实验表明，由于支票布局固定，简单的均值预测基线即可达到较高IoU，而基于切割-粘贴的合成数据在同等计算条件下并未带来可测量的性能提升，提示外观增强对固定布局文档效果有限。
AI.motivation: 现有IDRBT支票数据集缺少字段标注且许可证不明确，限制了其在自动支票处理研究中的应用。作者旨在解决这两个限制，提供可用的标注数据和合成数据资源。
AI.method: 1) 为IDRBT数据集中全部112张支票手工标注六个关键字段的边界框；2) 采用切割-粘贴流水线，从真实支票中提取标注字段区域，粘贴到内容擦除后的银行专用画布模板上，生成295张完全可再分发的合成支票图像；3) 使用ResNet-50直接回归模型作为基线，在单次前向传播中预测所有六个字段。
AI.result: 1) 无学习均值预测基线已达到0.691 mean IoU和80%的IoU≥0.5准确率；2) 在控制种子方差和训练计算量后，切割-粘贴合成数据相比仅使用真实数据未带来可测量改进，同等计算条件下纯真实数据模型在所有聚合指标上均匹配或优于合成增强模型。
AI.conclusion: 报告了这一负面结果，告诫不应假定仅依赖外观增强（appearance-only augmentation）就能帮助固定布局文档，未来方向应为布局变化的合成。同时发布了标注和合成图像作为可重用资源。
AI.abstract_zh: 自动支票处理需要在任何识别步骤之前定位关键字段（日期、法定金额、IFSC码、账号、签名和收款人姓名）。据我们所知，IDRBT支票图像数据集是唯一的公开印度银行支票数据集，但其发布时没有字段标注，也未声明许可证，因此其再分发条款不明确。我们解决了这两个限制。首先，我们为数据集中全部112张支票发布了六字段边界框标注，仅分发标注文件并与原始文件名关联，以尊重IDRBT的再分发条款。其次，我们发布了295张完全可再分发的合成支票图像，通过一种切割-粘贴流水线生成：将真实支票中的已标注字段区域合成到内容擦除后的银行专用画布模板上；由于补丁按其原始坐标粘贴，标注信息保持不变。第三，我们提供了一个ResNet-50直接回归基线模型，在单次前向传播中预测所有六个字段，并利用该模型对合成数据进行受控测试。测试结果令人警醒：由于支票布局固定，一个简单的无学习基线（仅预测每个字段的平均训练框）已达到0.691的平均IoU和80%的IoU≥0.5准确率；在考虑种子方差和训练计算量后，切割-粘贴合成数据相比仅使用真实数据未带来可测量的改进（同等计算条件下，纯真实数据模型在所有聚合指标上均匹配或优于合成增强模型）。我们完整报告了这一负面结果，因为它告诫不应认为仅依靠外观增强就能帮助固定布局文档，而是指向了需要布局变化的合成方法。我们已在Hugging Face Hub上以宽松许可证发布了标注和合成图像作为可重用资源。

title: DPD-KAN: Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks for Low Complexity Digital Predistortion in 5G Analog Radio-over-Fiber Systems
comment: Paper accepted for oral presentation at ECOC 2026
summary: We demonstrate the first KAN-based DPD model for 5G analog RoF fronthaul link, achieving a 24.2% lower EVM than multi-layer perceptron and 29.6% lower than Volterra-based GMP at equivalent Bit Operations. To attain an EVM below 2%, KAN requires ~52% fewer BOPs than a perceptron.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了首个基于KAN的DPD模型，用于5G模拟RoF前传链路，在同等比特运算量下，相比多层感知机和Volterra-based GMP分别实现了24.2%和29.6%的EVM降低，且达到低于2%的EVM所需BOPs比感知机少约52%。
AI.motivation: 传统的Volterra-based GMP和MLP模型在5G模拟RoF前传链路的数字预失真(DPD)中存在计算复杂度高或线性化性能不足的问题，亟需一种更高效、线性化能力更强的DPD方案。
AI.method: 提出基于KAN（Kolmogorov-Arnold Network）的DPD模型，用于5G模拟RoF前传链路的线性化处理。
AI.result: 1) 在同等比特运算量下，KAN-DPD的EVM比多层感知机低24.2%，比Volterra-based GMP低29.6%；2) 为达到低于2%的EVM，KAN所需BOPs比感知机少约52%。
AI.conclusion: KAN-based DPD模型在5G模拟RoF前传链路中展现出显著优于MLP和Volterra-based GMP的线性化性能与计算效率，是一种极具前景的DPD方案。
AI.abstract_zh: 我们展示了首个基于KAN的DPD模型，用于5G模拟RoF前传链路。在同等比特运算量下，该模型相比多层感知机实现了24.2%的误差矢量幅度(EVM)降低，相比基于Volterra的广义记忆多项式(GMP)实现了29.6%的EVM降低。为达到低于2%的EVM，KAN所需的比特运算次数(BOPs)比感知机少约52%。

title: Delay coordinates synchronization and induces abrupt transition in excitable networks
summary: Neuronal communication is inherently time-delayed, due to the finite speed of signal propagation. Although often considered challenging or disruptive, such time delays can also endow neural circuits with useful capabilities. Here, we show that delays in excitatory connections between excitable neurons coordinate their synchronization patterns by creating self-sustained oscillations that may be out-of-phase or in-phase. The emergence of these oscillations leads to an abrupt, explosive, transition to in-phase synchronized regimes due to small changes in connection strength or time-delay. We describe the mechanism underlying these phenomena as an interaction between the neuron's excitable dynamics and the delay in signal transmission, explaining many aspects of how the oscillations emerge. We show this phenomenon in different network connectivities, neuronal models, with and without excitation, with and without noise, highlighting the generality of the mechanism.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了兴奋性连接中的时间延迟如何协调神经回路中的同步模式，发现延迟会导致自维持振荡，并引发从异相同步到同相同步的突变（爆炸性）转变，揭示了这一机制在不同网络连接性和神经模型中的普适性。
AI.motivation: 理解神经通信中不可避免的时间延迟（由于信号传播速度有限）对神经回路动力学的影响，特别是延迟如何从通常被视为干扰因素转变为赋予神经回路有用功能的机制。
AI.method: 通过理论分析和数值模拟，研究兴奋性连接中的时间延迟如何与神经元的可激发动力学相互作用，在不同网络拓扑结构、不同神经元模型（含/不含兴奋性、含/不含噪声）中分析同步模式的涌现和转变。
AI.result: 发现了延迟诱导的自维持振荡（可表现为异相或同相），以及连接强度或时间延迟的微小变化会引发向同相同步的突然爆炸性转变，并阐明了这一现象源于神经元可激发动力学与信号传输延迟之间的相互作用。
AI.conclusion: 时间延迟在神经回路中不仅是挑战，还能通过非线性动力学机制赋予神经回路有用的同步能力；该机制在多种网络连接性和神经元模型中具有普适性。
AI.abstract_zh: 神经元通信本质上存在时间延迟，这是由于信号传播速度有限所致。尽管时间延迟常被视为具有挑战性或破坏性，但它们也能赋予神经回路有用的能力。本文表明，可兴奋神经元之间兴奋性连接中的延迟通过产生可能异相或同相的自维持振荡来协调它们的同步模式。这些振荡的出现导致了一个突变性的、爆炸性的转变为同相同步状态，该转变由连接强度或时间延迟的微小变化引发。我们描述了这些现象背后的机制，即神经元可激发动力学与信号传输延迟之间的相互作用，解释了振荡如何涌现的多个方面。我们在不同的网络连接性、神经元模型、有无兴奋性、有无噪声的条件下展示了这一现象，突显了该机制的普适性。

title: Massive Activations Are Architecturally Robust: A Controlled Scratch/Commitment Residual Stream Test
summary: Trained transformers reliably develop massive activations, a small number of hidden dimensions whose magnitude is far above the median and which concentrate on the sequence-start token. Whether these outliers are a removable artifact of the residual stream's overloaded read and write role, or instead a functional necessity, is actively debated. We test the artifact hypothesis directly, with an architectural intervention. Our architecture, Ledger Residuals, splits the residual stream into a mutable scratch stream (Deliberation) that intermediate computation may freely overwrite and a protected, decode-only accumulator (Commitment) that holds the representation the model reads out. If massive activations exist only because one stream is forced to be both scratchpad and answer, then a dedicated answer channel should remove the need for them. We find that it does not. In matched-loss language models at the 160M and 290M scales, the model rebuilds the canonical fixed-dimension, start-token outlier inside the protected channel. The rebuilt feature is smaller in magnitude than in a standard transformer but more sharply concentrated on the start token, and a stronger sparsity penalty makes it more persistent and more concentrated still, rather than removing it. Massive activations therefore look architecturally robust: they re-emerge in whichever representation the model decodes from, which is what we would expect if they are functional rather than incidental. We release our architecture and measurement code.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Ledger Residuals架构，通过将残差流分为可写的“思考”流和保护的“承诺”流，检验大规模激活（outliers）是否为残差流过载导致的伪影。实验发现，即使提供了专用的解码通道，模型仍会在该保护通道中重建出固定在起始token上的大规模激活，且更强的稀疏惩罚反而使其更集中，表明这些激活是功能性的而非偶然的架构伪影。
AI.motivation: 当前关于Transformer中大规模激活（massive activations）的成因存在争议：一种观点认为它们是残差流同时承担读写双重角色导致的伪影（artifact），另一种观点则认为它们是模型功能上的必要组成部分。本文旨在直接检验“伪影假说”，判断这些异常激活是否可以通过架构干预被消除。
AI.method: 提出Ledger Residuals架构，将残差流拆分为两个独立通道：可被中间计算自由覆写的“思考”（Deliberation）流，以及受保护、仅用于解码读取的“承诺”（Commitment）流。如果大规模激活仅仅是残差流过载的伪影，那么提供一个专用的解码通道应能消除它们。在160M和290M参数规模的匹配损失语言模型上进行实验验证。
AI.result: 实验发现，即使提供了受保护的专用解码通道，模型仍会在该通道中重建出固定在起始token上的大规模激活。虽然重建的特征在幅度上小于标准Transformer，但在起始token上的集中程度更高。更强的稀疏性惩罚（sparsity penalty）不会消除这些异常激活，反而使其更持久、更集中。
AI.conclusion: 大规模激活在架构上具有鲁棒性：无论模型从哪个表征通道解码，它们都会重新出现。这一结果支持这些激活是功能性的而非偶然性的伪影，挑战了“伪影假说”。
AI.abstract_zh: 训练后的Transformer会可靠地产生大规模激活（massive activations），即一小部分隐藏维度，其量级远高于中位数，并且集中在序列起始token上。这些异常值究竟是由残差流读写角色过载导致的可移除伪影，还是功能上的必要组成部分，目前存在激烈争议。我们通过一种架构干预直接检验了伪影假说。我们的架构——Ledger Residuals（分类账残差）——将残差流拆分为一个可变的暂存流（思考，Deliberation），中间计算可自由覆写该流；以及一个受保护的、仅用于解码的累加器（承诺，Commitment），用于保存模型最终读取的表征。如果大规模激活的存在仅仅是因为同一个流被迫同时充当暂存器和答案通道，那么一个专用的答案通道应当能消除这种需求。我们发现事实并非如此。在160M和290M参数规模的匹配损失语言模型中，模型在受保护通道内重建了规范化的固定维度、起始token异常值。相比标准Transformer，重建的特征在量级上更小，但在起始token上的集中程度更高；更强的稀疏性惩罚非但没有移除它，反而使其更持久、更集中。因此，大规模激活在架构上看起来是鲁棒的：它们会在模型解码所依赖的任意表征中重新出现，这正是我们预期它们具备功能性而非偶然性时的表现。我们已公开架构和测量代码。

title: LLM-Driven Heuristic Frame-Level Quantization Parameter Adaptation for VVenC
summary: Optimal frame-level quantization parameter (QP) allocation remains a persistent challenge in modern video encoders. The fixed-QP scheme widely adopted in practical systems is inherently content-agnostic, while classical Lagrangian rate-distortion optimization (RDO) methods often suffer from inaccurate multiplier settings. In this paper, we explore the use of large language models (LLMs) to automatically design RDO heuristics for frame-level QP adaptation. We construct a closed-loop evolutionary framework in which the LLM iteratively proposes RDO heuristics as algorithmic ideas with executable code, and these candidates are evaluated directly through encoding with the Fraunhofer Versatile Video Encoder (VVenC), where each heuristic acts as a scoring function that compares different QP choices based on the encoding statistics of past frames and current candidates. Experimental results across multiple test sets show that the evolved heuristic achieves promising rate-distortion improvements over both the fixed-QP scheme and the Lagrangian baseline. Further analysis reveals that the LLM can autonomously discover an adaptive heuristic that penalizes QP fluctuations via entropy-based terms, providing new insights into the design of RDO algorithms

AI.tldr: 本文提出利用大语言模型(LLM)在闭环进化框架中自动设计帧级QP分配的RDO启发式策略，实验表明该方法相比固定QP方案和拉格朗日基线取得了显著的率失真改进，且LLM能自主发现一种通过熵项惩罚QP波动的自适应启发式方法。
AI.motivation: 现代视频编码器中固定QP方案是内容无关的，而传统拉格朗日率失真优化方法常因不准确的乘子设置而导致性能不佳，因此需要一种自动化的、内容自适应的帧级QP分配方法。
AI.method: 构建闭环进化框架：LLM迭代地提出RDO启发式策略（包含算法思想和可执行代码），将这些候选启发式作为评分函数，基于过去帧的编码统计和当前候选来比较不同QP选择，并通过Fraunhofer Versatile Video Encoder (VVenC)实际编码进行评估。
AI.result: 多个测试集上的实验结果表明，进化得到的启发式策略相比固定QP方案和拉格朗日基线均取得了显著的率失真改进。进一步分析发现LLM能自主发现一种通过熵项惩罚QP波动的自适应启发式方法。
AI.conclusion: LLM能够自动设计有效的RDO启发式策略用于帧级QP自适应，为率失真优化算法的设计提供了新思路。
AI.abstract_zh: 在现代视频编码器中，最优帧级量化参数(QP)分配始终是一个持续的挑战。实际系统中广泛采用的固定QP方案本质上是内容无关的，而经典的拉格朗日率失真优化(RDO)方法常常因不准确的乘子设置而性能不佳。本文探索利用大语言模型(LLM)自动设计用于帧级QP自适应的RDO启发式策略。我们构建了一个闭环进化框架，其中LLM迭代地提出RDO启发式策略作为携带可执行代码的算法思想，这些候选策略通过Fraunhofer Versatile Video Encoder (VVenC)直接编码进行评估，每个启发式策略作为一个评分函数，基于过去帧和当前候选的编码统计来比较不同QP选择。多个测试集上的实验结果表明，进化得到的启发式策略相比固定QP方案和拉格朗日基线均取得了显著的率失真改进。进一步分析揭示，LLM能够自主发现一种通过熵项惩罚QP波动的自适应启发式方法，为RDO算法的设计提供了新见解。

title: Shear-Free Viewport Magnification for 360-Degree via Spherical Mobius Boosts
summary: Viewport-adaptive 360-degree imaging seeks to allocate a fixed sampling budget to the region a viewer is likely to observe. Existing view-biased projections increase viewport resolution through non-conformal warps, which can introduce anisotropic stretching and shear. We formulate spherical Mobius boosts as exact conformal maps for fixed-budget viewport magnification. The continuous spherical warp has quasiconformal dilatation K = 1, reallocating samples toward a target direction while preserving local angles. On a SUN360 saliency audit with 72 panoramas and 216 paired viewport targets, C1 Mobius boosting improves viewport PSNR over optimized offset cubemap on all paired cases, with case-level median gain +3.26 dB, image-level median gain +3.23 dB, and panorama-level bootstrap 95% CI [+3.15, +3.33] dB. Pareto analysis shows that this is not a free global-quality improvement: C1 trades full-sphere WS-PSNR for shear-free viewport fidelity. Prediction-error and filtering studies identify the operating envelope: strong boosts are useful for accurately targeted viewports, while large target uncertainty calls for weaker boosts or fallback. These results position Mobius boosting as a geometric primitive for prediction-conditioned foveated 360-degree resampling rather than a universal encode-once layout.

AI.tldr: 本文提出球面Möbius变换（称为Möbius boosting），用于视口自适应360度成像。这是一种精确的共形映射，在固定采样预算下实现视口放大，同时保持局部角度不变（拟共形伸缩率K=1）。实验表明，相比优化的偏移立方体贴图，该方法在所有配对案例上获得中位+3.26 dB的PSNR增益。但这不是免费的全局质量提升，而是以牺牲全球面WS-PSNR为代价换取无剪切视口保真度。该方法定位为预测条件驱动的注视点360度重采样的几何基元，而非通用的一次编码布局。
AI.motivation: 现有视口自适应360度成像方法使用非共形扭曲（如视偏投影）来提升视口分辨率，但会引入各向异性拉伸和剪切变形。作者希望找到一种既能分配更多采样给目标视口、又能避免畸变的映射方法。
AI.method: 将球面Möbius变换（Möbius boosting）公式化为精确的共形映射，用于固定预算的视口放大。该连续球面扭曲的拟共形伸缩率K=1，在保持局部角度的同时将采样重新分配至目标方向。
AI.result: 在SUN360显著性审核数据集（72张全景图、216对配对视口目标）上进行实验：C1 Möbius boosting在所有配对案例上均优于优化的偏移立方体贴图，案例级中位增益+3.26 dB，图像级中位增益+3.23 dB，全景级bootstrap 95%置信区间[+3.15, +3.33] dB。帕累托分析表明该方法并非免费提升全局质量——C1以牺牲全球面WS-PSNR为代价换取无剪切视口保真度。预测误差和滤波研究界定了有效工作范围：强增强适用于准确瞄准的视口，大目标不确定性则需要弱增强或回退策略。
AI.conclusion: Möbius boosting应定位为预测条件驱动的注视点360度重采样的几何基元，而非通用的编码一次布局。
AI.abstract_zh: 视口自适应360度成像旨在将固定的采样预算分配给观众可能观察的区域。现有的视偏投影通过非共形扭曲提高视口分辨率，这可能引入各向异性拉伸和剪切。我们将球面Möbius变换（Möbius boosting）公式化为固定预算视口放大的精确共形映射。这种连续球面扭曲的拟共形伸缩率K=1，在保持局部角度的同时将采样重新分配至目标方向。在包含72张全景图和216个配对视口目标的SUN360显著性审核数据集上，C1 Möbius boosting在所有配对案例上均优于优化的偏移立方体贴图，案例级中位增益为+3.26 dB，图像级中位增益为+3.23 dB，全景级bootstrap 95%置信区间为[+3.15, +3.33] dB。帕累托分析表明，这并非免费的全局质量提升：C1以牺牲全球面WS-PSNR为代价换取无剪切视口保真度。预测误差和滤波研究界定了其有效工作范围：强增强适用于准确瞄准的视口，而大目标不确定性则需要弱增强或回退策略。这些结果将Möbius boosting定位为预测条件驱动的注视点360度重采样的几何基元，而非通用的编码一次布局。

title: Physics-Informed Neural Optimization Based Antenna Coding Design for Pixel Antenna Systems
comment: 5 pages, 5 figures, accepted by IEEE SPAWC 2026
summary: Pixel antennas enable highly radiation pattern reconfigurability to enhance wireless systems, but its antenna coding design, that is optimizing the states of switches embedded in pixel antennas, remains an NP-hard challenge. Conventional approaches for antenna coding design typically rely on heuristic search algorithms, which suffer from high computational complexity. To overcome this issue, we propose a novel efficient data-free optimization algorithm called physics-informed neural optimizer (PINO) for antenna coding design. By integrating a deep convolutional neural network prior and a Gumbel-Sigmoid continuous relaxation into a differentiable physics engine, the proposed algorithm transforms the binary optimization problem into a continuous differentiable problem, which enables the antenna coding optimization problem to be efficiently solved via gradient descent. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed algorithm outperforms the heuristic search based algorithms, reducing computational time while achieving higher average channel gain.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为物理信息神经优化器（PINO）的数据自由优化算法，通过将深度卷积神经网络先验和Gumbel-Sigmoid连续松弛集成到可微物理引擎中，将天线编码的二元优化问题转化为连续可微问题，从而高效求解，相比启发式搜索算法降低了计算时间并提高了平均信道增益。
AI.motivation: 像素天线的编码设计（优化天线中开关状态）是一个NP难问题，传统启发式搜索算法计算复杂度高，亟需一种更高效的优化方法。
AI.method: 提出物理信息神经优化器（PINO），将深度卷积神经网络先验与Gumbel-Sigmoid连续松弛技术集成到可微物理引擎中，将二元优化问题转化为连续可微问题，从而通过梯度下降高效求解。
AI.result: 仿真结果表明，所提算法优于基于启发式搜索的算法，在降低计算时间的同时实现了更高的平均信道增益。
AI.conclusion: PINO算法能够有效解决像素天线编码设计的NP难问题，在计算效率和性能上均优于传统启发式方法。
AI.abstract_zh: 像素天线能够实现高度方向图可重构性以增强无线系统性能，但其天线编码设计——即优化像素天线中嵌入的开关状态——仍然是一个NP难问题。传统的天线编码设计方法通常依赖启发式搜索算法，计算复杂度高。为克服这一问题，我们提出了一种新颖高效的无数据优化算法，称为物理信息神经优化器（PINO），用于天线编码设计。通过将深度卷积神经网络先验和Gumbel-Sigmoid连续松弛集成到可微物理引擎中，该算法将二元优化问题转化为连续可微问题，从而能够通过梯度下降高效求解天线编码优化问题。仿真结果表明，所提算法优于基于启发式搜索的算法，在降低计算时间的同时实现了更高的平均信道增益。

title: Mostly-monocular responses and other visual functions in a multiscale network model of Macaque V1
summary: Visual signals from the two eyes merge gradually as they pass through the primary visual cortex (V1). Here we use a computational model of Macaque V1 to study the first stage of this integration \ktext{along the magnocellular pathway}, in layer 4C$α$, aiming to infer neuroanatomical origins of binocular response. \ktext{It is known that neurons in layer 4C$α$ are predominantly monocular, \ytext{though} some do exhibit varying degrees of binocularity. We find (1) the emergence of narrow binocular strips along borders of ocular dominance columns (ODC), a finding that aligns with experiments; (2) most consistent with data is when $10-30\%$ of interactions near ODC boundaries are cross-columnar; and (3) feedback from layer 6 is largely monocular.} These results were obtained through systematic hypothesis testing using a multiscale model that is orders of magnitude faster than its biologically-detailed predecessors. We propose that multiscale modeling can be an effective tool for bridging anatomy and function.

AI.tldr: 本文通过猕猴V1区计算模型研究双眼视觉信号在初级视皮层4Cα层的初步整合机制，发现眼优势柱边界处存在窄双目条带，并指出10-30%的跨柱交互和6层反馈的单眼特性是解释实验数据的关键。
AI.motivation: 探究双眼视觉信号在初级视皮层（V1）4Cα层（大细胞通路）中整合的神经解剖学起源，尤其是揭示该层中双眼响应的产生机制。
AI.method: 使用猕猴V1区多尺度计算模型（比传统生物细节模型快数个数量级），通过系统假设检验来模拟和分析4Cα层神经元对双眼刺激的响应特性。
AI.result: (1) 眼优势柱边界处出现窄双目条带，与实验观察一致；(2) 当眼优势柱边界附近10-30%的交互为跨柱交互时，模型最符合实验数据；(3) 第6层的反馈主要是单眼的。
AI.conclusion: 多尺度建模可作为连接神经解剖结构与功能的有效桥梁工具。
AI.abstract_zh: 来自两只眼睛的视觉信号在通过初级视皮层（V1）时逐渐合并。本文使用猕猴V1区的计算模型，沿大细胞通路研究这一整合过程的第一阶段——位于4Cα层，旨在推断双眼响应的神经解剖学起源。已知4Cα层的神经元主要为单眼驱动，但部分神经元确实表现出不同程度的双眼性。我们发现：（1）在眼优势柱边界处出现窄双目条带，这一发现与实验结果一致；（2）当眼优势柱边界附近10-30%的交互为跨柱交互时，模型与数据的匹配程度最高；（3）第6层的反馈主要是单眼的。这些结果是通过多尺度模型进行系统假设检验获得的，该模型的计算速度比其生物细节的前代模型快数个数量级。我们提出，多尺度建模可以成为连接解剖结构与功能的有效工具。

title: CIExplainer++: Generating Causal and Interpretable Explanations for Graph Neural Networks
summary:
Explainable Artificial Intelligence aims to make black-box models more trustworthy by presenting, in a human-understandable manner, the elements that lead to the model's output. This involves both (i) identifying components and connections with genuine causal influence on outputs and (ii) translating such structures into an interpretable representation. For the former, we introduce CIExplainer, a novel perturbation-based method grounded in causal inference for explaining Graph Neural Networks (GNNs). CIExplainer identifies the subgraph with the highest causal effects on GNN predictions using the Potential Outcome Framework. We evaluate and compare CIExplainer on various GNN architectures (GCN, GraphSAGE, GAT, GIN) and datasets.
  To bridge subgraph explanations with human interpretability, we further propose G2TeXplainer, a method that transforms causal subgraphs into natural language explanations that capture both feature-level and relational information.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CIExplainer和G2TeXplainer两个方法，分别用于基于因果推断识别GNN中真正影响输出的子图，以及将因果子图转化为自然语言解释，从而提升GNN的可解释性和可信度。
AI.motivation: 现有GNN解释方法未能有效区分真正的因果影响与虚假关联，且子图形式的解释对人类不够直观，因此需要从因果推断视角识别真正影响模型输出的子图，并将其转化为人类可理解的自然语言。
AI.method: CIExplainer：基于潜在结果框架的扰动方法，识别对GNN预测具有最高因果效应的子图；G2TeXplainer：将因果子图转化为包含特征级和关系级信息的自然语言解释。
AI.result: 在多种GNN架构（GCN、GraphSAGE、GAT、GIN）和数据集上评估了CIExplainer，验证了其有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过结合因果推断的CIExplainer和自然语言生成的G2TeXplainer，实现了从因果子图识别到人类可理解解释的完整流程，提升了GNN模型的可解释性与可信度。
AI.abstract_zh: 可解释人工智能旨在通过以人类可理解的方式呈现导致模型输出的元素，使黑盒模型更加可信。这既包括（i）识别对输出具有真正因果影响的组件和连接，也包括（ii）将这些结构转化为可解释的表示。针对前者，我们提出了CIExplainer，一种基于因果推断的新型扰动方法，用于解释图神经网络（GNN）。CIExplainer利用潜在结果框架识别对GNN预测具有最高因果效应的子图。我们在多种GNN架构（GCN、GraphSAGE、GAT、GIN）和数据集上评估并比较了CIExplainer。为将子图解释与人类可解释性相衔接，我们进一步提出了G2TeXplainer，一种将因果子图转化为同时包含特征级和关系级信息的自然语言解释的方法。

title: FlowCodec: One-Step Flow Prior for Generative Image Compression
summary: Diffusion-based image compression methods, leveraging powerful generative priors, have demonstrated remarkable perceptual quality at ultra-low bitrates. However, adapting modern generative models to image compression often relies on carefully engineered conditioning or auxiliary branches, together with substantial retraining, and these costs grow as the models scale. This motivates an open question: Can stronger generative priors be integrated into compression through a simpler, more extensible design? To answer this, we propose FlowCodec, a streamlined framework that plugs pretrained large-scale text-to-image priors (e.g., Qwen-image-2512 and FLUX.1-dev) into ultra-low-bitrate codecs. FlowCodec decomposes the pipeline into two decoupled stages: (1) Latent Compression, which maps clean latents to bitrate-constrained noisy latents; and (2) Latent Transport, which leverages the pretrained prior to refine the noisy latents toward the clean ones in a single step. Notably, FlowCodec requires neither additional conditioning signals nor auxiliary networks. Furthermore, with lightweight adaptation, it can flexibly support multiple bitrates while keeping the number of trainable parameters below 0.54% of the generative backbone. Experiments show that FlowCodec preserves high visual quality at bitrates below 0.05 bits per pixel. The Qwen-image variant significantly outperforms existing methods in terms of LPIPS and DISTS, while both variants deliver higher PSNR and clearly faster encoding than existing one-step diffusion-based methods, with the FLUX variant also maintaining competitive decoding speed.

AI.tldr: FlowCodec提出了一种轻量级框架，将预训练的大规模文生图模型集成到超低比特率图像压缩中，通过解耦的潜空间压缩和单步潜空间传输两个阶段，无需额外条件信号或辅助网络，在低于0.05 bpp的比特率下实现了卓越的感知质量。
AI.motivation: 现有的扩散式图像压缩方法通常需要精心设计的条件机制或辅助分支，并且需要大量重训练，这些成本随着模型规模扩大而增长。作者希望探索一种更简单、更具扩展性的设计，将更强的生成先验集成到压缩中。
AI.method: FlowCodec将流程解耦为两个阶段：(1) 潜空间压缩——将干净潜变量映射到比特率受限的噪声潜变量；(2) 潜空间传输——利用预训练生成先验通过单步将噪声潜变量精炼为干净潜变量。该框架无需额外的条件信号或辅助网络，且通过轻量级适配可灵活支持多种比特率，可训练参数不到生成主干的0.54%。
AI.result: 在低于0.05 bpp的比特率下保持高视觉质量；Qwen-image变体在LPIPS和DISTS指标上显著优于现有方法；两种变体在PSNR和编码速度上均优于现有的单步扩散方法；FLUX变体在解码速度上也具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: FlowCodec证明了通过解耦设计和轻量级适配，可以将更强的生成先验以更简单、更具扩展性的方式集成到图像压缩中，在超低比特率下实现卓越的感知质量和高效的编解码速度。
AI.abstract_zh: 基于扩散的图像压缩方法利用强大的生成先验，在超低比特率下展现出了卓越的感知质量。然而，将现代生成模型适配到图像压缩通常依赖于精心设计的条件机制或辅助分支，以及大量的重训练，并且这些成本随着模型规模的扩大而增加。这引出了一个开放性问题：能否通过一种更简单、更具扩展性的设计，将更强的生成先验集成到压缩中？为了回答这一问题，我们提出了FlowCodec，一个精简的框架，将预训练的大规模文生图先验（例如Qwen-image-2512和FLUX.1-dev）嵌入到超低比特率编解码器中。FlowCodec将流程解耦为两个独立的阶段：（1）潜空间压缩，将干净潜变量映射到比特率受限的噪声潜变量；（2）潜空间传输，利用预训练先验通过单步将噪声潜变量精炼为干净潜变量。值得注意的是，FlowCodec既不需要额外的条件信号，也不需要辅助网络。此外，通过轻量级适配，它可以灵活支持多种比特率，同时可训练参数数量保持在生成主干的0.54%以下。实验表明，FlowCodec在低于0.05 bits per pixel的比特率下仍能保持高视觉质量。Qwen-image变体在LPIPS和DISTS指标上显著优于现有方法，而两种变体在PSNR和编码速度上都明显快于现有的单步扩散方法，同时FLUX变体在解码速度上也保持了竞争力。

title: ARGUSTRACK: A Multi-View Annotation System for Multi-Object Tracking
summary: Multi-Camera Multi-Target (MCMT) tracking has emerged as a critical capability for applications ranging from autonomous driving to animal behavior monitoring. While recent advances have yielded sophisticated tracking algorithms, the availability of annotated multi-view data remains a significant bottleneck. Existing annotation tools predominantly support single-camera workflows or rely on LiDAR sensors, making cross-view labeling tedious and impractical for camera-only setups. We present ARGUS-TRACK, a multi-camera annotation system that addresses these limitations by enabling annotators to work directly on a bird's-eye-view (BEV) plane. Given calibrated camera parameters, a single ground-plane annotation is automatically projected into 2D bounding boxes across all relevant views, inherently ensuring identity consistency without manual cross-view alignment. To further accelerate the labeling process, ARGUSTRACK incorporates two complementary mechanisms: a Temporal Aware module that propagates annotations from preceding frames to initialize new ones, requiring only minor positional adjustments; and a Multi-camera Semi-annotation module that leverages off-the-shelf 2D detectors combined with foot-point estimation to automatically generate candidate BEV positions for annotator verification. We evaluate ARGUSTRACK through a pilot study on multi-camera broiler tracking and demonstrate that it substantially reduces annotation time compared to conventional single-camera labeling workflows.

AI.tldr: 提出ARGUS-TRACK多相机标注系统，通过在鸟瞰图上直接标注，自动投影到各视角，并利用时序传播和多相机半自动标注模块加速标注过程，显著减少多目标多相机跟踪的标注时间。
AI.motivation: 多相机多目标跟踪领域缺乏高效的标注工具，现有工具多支持单相机工作流或依赖LiDAR传感器，跨视角标注繁琐且无法保证身份一致性，成为该领域的瓶颈。
AI.method: 1) 基于鸟瞰图(BEV)平面的单点标注自动投影到各视角生成2D边界框，保证身份一致性；2) 时序传播模块(Temporal Aware)从前帧传播标注初始化当前帧；3) 多相机半自动标注模块利用现成2D检测器结合足点估计自动生成候选BEV位置供人工验证。
AI.result: 通过多相机肉鸡跟踪的初步研究，表明相比传统单相机标注流程，ARGUS-TRACK显著减少了标注时间。
AI.conclusion: ARGUS-TRACK通过BEV平面标注、时序传播和半自动标注机制，有效解决了多相机多目标跟踪中跨视角标注繁琐、身份一致性难以保证的问题，大幅提升了标注效率。
AI.abstract_zh: 多相机多目标(MCMT)跟踪已成为从自动驾驶到动物行为监测等应用的关键能力。尽管近期进展催生了复杂的跟踪算法，但带标注的多视角数据的可用性仍然是一个显著的瓶颈。现有的标注工具主要支持单相机工作流或依赖LiDAR传感器，这使得跨视角标注变得繁琐且不适用于纯相机设置。我们提出了ARGUS-TRACK，一种多相机标注系统，通过使标注人员能够直接在鸟瞰图(BEV)平面上工作来解决这些限制。给定已标定的相机参数，单个地面平面标注会自动投影到所有相关视角的2D边界框上，从而无需手动跨视角对齐即可内在保证身份一致性。为进一步加速标注过程，ARGUS-TRACK整合了两种互补机制：时序感知模块，它将前一帧的标注传播以初始化新帧的标注，仅需要微小的位置调整；以及多相机半自动标注模块，它利用现成的2D检测器结合足点估计来自动生成候选BEV位置供标注人员验证。我们通过多相机肉鸡跟踪的初步研究评估了ARGUS-TRACK，并证明相比传统的单相机标注流程，它显著减少了标注时间。

title: Generative versus Discriminative Approaches for Class-Incremental Learning of EMG Signals: Effectiveness of Scale Mixture Modeling
comment: 7 pages, 4 figures, accepted at IEEE SMC 2026
summary: In electromyogram (EMG)-based motion recognition, it is impractical to predefine all motions that may be required during deployment, necessitating class-incremental learning that sequentially adds new motion classes. The primary challenges in class-incremental learning are catastrophic forgetting, where previously acquired knowledge is overwritten when learning new classes, and the memory cost of retaining past data to counteract it. In particular, for EMG-based motion recognition intended for edge devices with limited computational resources, it is essential to suppress catastrophic forgetting and maintain low memory cost. In this paper, we conducted a comparative evaluation of eight class-incremental learning methods spanning generative and discriminative approaches, including both deep and non-deep learning methods, for EMG signal classification. Using four datasets, we evaluated each method in terms of classification accuracy, backward transfer, and memory cost. The results demonstrated that deep learning-based methods suffered significant accuracy degradation from catastrophic forgetting as the number of tasks increased, whereas generative models maintained stable accuracy with low memory cost. Among generative models, the scale mixture classification model (SMCM), which captures EMG signal variability, achieved the most favorable accuracy-memory trade-off while effectively suppressing catastrophic forgetting across all datasets.

AI.tldr: 本文针对基于EMG的类增量学习，比较了八种方法（涵盖生成式与判别式、深度与非深度学习），发现生成模型（尤其是SMCM）在抑制灾难性遗忘和降低内存成本方面表现最优。
AI.motivation: 在基于EMG的动作识别中，无法预先定义所有可能的动作类别，需要能够顺序添加新类的增量学习。但类增量学习面临灾难性遗忘和内存成本两大挑战，尤其在资源受限的边缘设备上，需同时抑制遗忘和降低内存开销。
AI.method: 对八种类增量学习方法进行对比评估，包括生成式与判别式方法、深度与非深度学习方法，在四个EMG数据集上从分类准确率、反向迁移和内存成本三个维度进行系统评价。
AI.result: 深度学习方法随任务数增加因灾难性遗忘导致准确率显著下降；生成模型在低内存成本下保持稳定准确率；其中尺度混合分类模型（SMCM）在所有数据集上实现了最佳的准确率-内存权衡，并有效抑制了灾难性遗忘。
AI.conclusion: 生成模型，特别是能够捕获EMG信号变异性的SMCM，是解决EMG类增量学习中灾难性遗忘和内存成本问题的高效方案。
AI.abstract_zh: 在基于肌电图（EMG）的动作识别中，预先定义部署过程中可能需要的所有动作是不切实际的，因此需要能够顺序添加新动作类别的类增量学习。类增量学习的主要挑战是灾难性遗忘（学习新类别时先前知识被覆盖）以及为对抗遗忘而保留过往数据带来的内存成本。特别地，对于面向计算资源有限的边缘设备的EMG动作识别，抑制灾难性遗忘并保持低内存成本至关重要。本文对八种类增量学习方法进行了比较评估，涵盖生成式与判别式方法、深度与非深度学习方法，用于EMG信号分类。利用四个数据集，我们从分类准确率、反向迁移和内存成本三个维度评价了每种方法。结果表明，随着任务数量增加，基于深度学习的方法因灾难性遗忘而出现显著的准确率下降，而生成模型在低内存成本下保持了稳定的准确率。在生成模型中，能够捕获EMG信号变异性的尺度混合分类模型（SMCM）在所有数据集上实现了最有利的准确率-内存权衡，同时有效抑制了灾难性遗忘。

title: Dynamic Computerized Tumbling-E Testing for Temporal Reliability of Human Sequential Perceptual Decisions
summary: OBJECTIVES: Visual acuity and tumbling-E tasks are often treated as static threshold measures, yet sequential perceptual decisions unfold over time. A computerized tumbling-E task preserves response latency, timeouts, and stimulus-size adaptation, creating a temporal reliability dataset rather than only a chart-line score. This matters for human-AI comparison because the Temporal Hallucination Index (THI) shows how static accuracy can obscure delays, drift, persistence, and unstable convergence. METHODS: We curated trial-level human data from a computerized dynamic tumbling-E task. On each trial, a single E optotype appeared in one of four orientations, participants selected the perceived direction or timed out, and stimulus size was automatically adjusted through an adaptive staircase. Primary outcomes were reaction time, timeout rate, delay rate above a 3-second budget, and observable THI based on delay and timeout components. RESULTS: The final dataset included 1,154 valid trials from 21 human identifiers across 77 sessions. There were 1,078 non-timeout responses and 76 timeouts, giving a 6.6% timeout rate. Non-timeout reaction times centered near 1.5 seconds (mean 1546 ms; median 1506 ms; IQR 1306-1713 ms), with only 3 responses exceeding 3,000 ms. Adaptation was dominated by smaller-next-stimulus transitions (89.2%). Mean arcminutes declined from 29.42 at trial 0 to 5.04 at trial 19, supporting convergence near a 20/20-level optotype without clinical acuity diagnosis. CONCLUSIONS: This dataset converts a tumbling-E visual task into a temporally resolved human perceptual-decision benchmark. Its novel contribution is automatic capture of staircase behavior, response timing, timeouts, and trial-level reliability signals. The human data show fast timing and smooth adaptation toward threshold, establishing a human-only baseline for future comparison with artificial agents.

AI.tldr: 本文通过计算机化的动态“E”视力任务，构建了一个包含反应时、超时率和自适应阶梯行为的时间分辨率人类感知决策基准数据集，并引入时间幻觉指数（THI）以揭示静态准确性指标可能掩盖的延迟、漂移和不稳定收敛问题。
AI.motivation: 传统的视力和“E”视力任务通常被视为静态阈值测量，忽略了时序感知决策过程。为支持人类与人工智能对比，需要一种能捕捉反应延迟、超时、刺激大小自适应等时间动态信息的数据集，而静态图表分数无法反映这些关键特征。
AI.method: 收集了来自计算机化动态“E”视力任务的试次级人类数据：每试次呈现单个E视标（四种方向之一），参与者选择感知方向或超时，通过自适应阶梯法自动调整刺激大小。主要指标包括反应时、超时率、超过3秒预算的延迟率，以及基于延迟和超时组件的可观察THI。
AI.result: 最终数据集包含来自21名参与者在77次会话中的1,154个有效试次。非超时反应1,078次，超时76次（超时率6.6%）；非超时反应时中位数约1.5秒（均值1546 ms，中位数1506 ms，IQR 1306–1713 ms），仅3次反应超过3000 ms。较小刺激过渡占比89.2%，平均弧分从试次0的29.42下降到试次19的5.04，趋近20/20水平的视标。
AI.conclusion: 该数据集将“E”视力任务转化为时间分辨率的人类感知决策基准，其新颖贡献在于自动捕获阶梯行为、反应时序、超时和试次级可靠性信号。人类数据显示快速时序和向阈值的平滑自适应，为未来与人工代理的比较建立了纯人类基线。
AI.abstract_zh: 目的：视力和“E”视力任务常被当作静态阈值测量来处理，然而序列感知决策是随时间展开的。计算机化的“E”视力任务保留了反应延迟、超时和刺激大小自适应，创建了一个时间可靠性数据集而不仅仅是图表线得分。这对人类与人工智能比较至关重要，因为时间幻觉指数（THI）揭示了静态准确性如何掩盖延迟、漂移、持久性以及不稳定的收敛。方法：我们整理了来自计算机化动态“E”视力任务的试次级人类数据。在每个试次中，单个E视标以四种方向之一出现，参与者选择感知方向或超时，刺激大小通过自适应阶梯法自动调整。主要结局指标为反应时、超时率、超过3秒预算的延迟率，以及基于延迟和超时组件的可观察THI。结果：最终数据集包含来自21名人类受试者在77次会话中的1,154个有效试次。其中有1,078次非超时响应和76次超时，超时率为6.6%。非超时反应时中位数约为1.5秒（均值1546 ms；中位数1506 ms；四分位距1306–1713 ms），仅有3次响应超过3000 ms。自适应以小刺激过渡为主（89.2%）。平均弧分从试次0的29.42下降到试次19的5.04，表明逼近20/20水平的视标，但并非临床视力诊断。结论：本数据集将“E”视力任务转化为时间分辨率的人类感知决策基准。其新颖贡献在于自动捕获阶梯行为、反应时序、超时以及试次级可靠性信号。人类数据显示了快速时序和向阈值的平滑自适应，为未来与人工代理的对比建立了纯人类基线。

title: Evidential Fusion Network for Multimodal Survival Prediction under Missing Modalities
summary: Recent multimodal survival prediction models have demonstrated strong predictive performance by leveraging complementary information across modalities. However, such models generally assume data completeness and exhibit limited robustness toward missing modalities, which are frequently encountered in real-world clinical settings. We propose the Evidential Missing Modality Survival Fusion (EMMS) model for multimodal survival prediction under missing modalities. EMMS offers a straightforward, computationally effective approach to survival analysis without requiring a generative phase for missing data. By employing Dempster-Shafer theory and Gaussian Random Fuzzy Numbers for multimodal decision fusion, it considers both aleatoric and epistemic uncertainty alongside modality reliability for fusion. Moreover, the model treats missing modalities as vacuous evidence, preventing interference with available inputs and naturally reflecting increased uncertainty and calibrated predictions. Extensive experiments on four cancer datasets demonstrate state-of-the-art performance while providing calibrated and interpretable uncertainty estimates under incomplete multimodal observations, without introducing additional computational overhead.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EMMS模型，利用Dempster-Shafer理论和高斯随机模糊数进行多模态决策融合，在无需数据生成的情况下有效处理缺失模态下的生存预测，同时提供校准的不确定性估计。
AI.motivation: 现有模态生存预测模型假设数据完整，对临床实践中常见的模态缺失情况鲁棒性不足，亟需一种无需生成式数据补全、能直接处理缺失模态的生存预测方法。
AI.method: 采用Dempster-Shafer理论和高斯随机模糊数进行多模态决策融合，同时考虑偶然不确定性和认知不确定性以及模态可靠性；将缺失模态视为空证据，避免对可用输入产生干扰。
AI.result: 在四个癌症数据集上的实验表明，该方法在模态不完整的情况下达到了最先进的预测性能，同时提供了校准且可解释的不确定性估计，且不引入额外计算开销。
AI.conclusion: EMMS提供了一种简单、计算高效的方法，在不依赖生成式缺失数据补全的情况下，实现了对缺失模态场景下多模态生存预测的鲁棒处理，并具备良好的不确定度校准能力。
AI.abstract_zh: 最近的多模态生存预测模型通过利用跨模态的互补信息展示了强大的预测性能。然而，这类模型通常假设数据完整性，对临床实际中频繁出现的模态缺失情况鲁棒性有限。我们提出了证据缺失模态生存融合（EMMS）模型，用于在模态缺失情况下进行多模态生存预测。EMMS提供了一种直接且计算高效的生存分析方法，无需对缺失数据进行生成式处理。通过采用Dempster-Shafer理论和高斯随机模糊数进行多模态决策融合，该模型同时考虑了偶然不确定性和认知不确定性以及模态可靠性进行融合。此外，该模型将缺失模态视为空证据，避免对可用输入产生干扰，自然地反映了增加的不确定性并提供校准的预测。在四个癌症数据集上的大量实验表明，该方法在不完整多模态观测下取得了最先进的性能，同时提供了校准且可解释的不确定性估计，且未引入额外的计算开销。

title: MoECodec: Image Compression for joint human and machine perception via Mixture-of-Experts
summary: Image compression for machines calls for a unified codec that serves multiple downstream vision tasks. Existing approaches either adopt task-specific end-to-end designs, raising parameter and deployment overhead, or rely on transfer-based adaptations that remain externally attached and heuristic task design. A key limitation shared by both lines of work is their largely static computation pattern, which applies similar transformations across tokens despite the fact that different image regions exhibit markedly different semantic importance and complexity for machine perception. We propose MoECodec, a token-aware image compression framework that supports multiple downstream tasks within a single model. MoECodec replaces the FFN layers in transformer-based compression model token-wise Mixture-of-Experts (MoE), enabling dynamic, token-level computation conditioned on the input content and task objective. To make MoE effective in compression model, we introduce a stable routing strategy that combines expert-choice routing with spatial total variation regularization to encourage spatially coherent assignments, and we propose a lightweight expert architecture, Group Shuffle MLP (GShMLP), to control parameter growth. Extensive experiments show consistent improvement against baselines on both conventional image reconstruction and machine tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出MoECodec，一种基于token级混合专家（MoE）的图像压缩框架，通过动态路由和轻量级专家模块，在单一模型中同时支持多个下游机器视觉任务。
AI.motivation: 现有面向机器的图像压缩方法存在两大局限：一是任务特定端到端设计导致参数与部署开销大；二是基于迁移学习的方案仍依赖启发式任务设计且计算模式静态，无法根据图像区域不同的语义重要性和复杂度进行差异化处理。
AI.method: 在Transformer压缩模型中将FFN层替换为token级混合专家（MoE），引入结合专家选择路由与空间全变差正则化的稳定路由策略以鼓励空间连贯分配，并提出轻量级专家架构Group Shuffle MLP（GShMLP）控制参数增长。
AI.result: 在传统图像重建和多个机器视觉任务上，相比基线方法取得了一致的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: MoECodec通过token级动态计算和共享多任务表示，有效解决了面向机器图像压缩中静态计算与任务迁移的局限，为统一码流设计提供了新范式。
AI.abstract_zh: 面向机器的图像压缩需要一种统一的编解码器，以服务于多个下游视觉任务。现有方法要么采用任务特定的端到端设计，导致参数和部署开销增加，要么依赖基于迁移学习的适配方案，这些方案仍然是外部附加的且任务设计具有启发性。这两类工作的一个共同局限在于其计算模式高度静态化——尽管不同图像区域对于机器感知具有显著不同的语义重要性和复杂度，它们仍对各个token施加相似的变换。我们提出MoECodec，一种token感知的图像压缩框架，能够在单一模型中支持多个下游任务。MoECodec将基于Transformer的压缩模型中的前馈网络层替换为token级混合专家（MoE），实现了基于输入内容和任务目标的动态、token级计算。为了使MoE在压缩模型中有效运行，我们引入了一种稳定的路由策略，将专家选择路由与空间全变差正则化相结合，以鼓励空间连贯的分配；同时，我们提出了一种轻量级专家架构——组洗牌MLP（GShMLP），以控制参数增长。大量实验表明，在传统图像重建和机器任务上，该方法相较基线取得了一致的性能提升。

title: NeoJaundice-AI: Smartphone-Based Neonatal Jaundice Detection Using Dual-Input Deep Learning and Synthetic Augmentation
comment: 7 pages, 10 figures, 8 tables. IEEE conference format
summary:
Neonatal jaundice (hyperbilirubinemia) is one of the most common conditions affecting newborns worldwide, with India alone recording roughly 15 million cases per year. Early detection is critical, yet standard diagnosis requires blood tests that are often impractical in rural clinics where laboratory facilities are limited. This paper presents NeoJaundice-AI, a smartphone-based screening system that uses photographs of a baby's skin and sclera (eye white) to estimate jaundice severity and predict serum bilirubin levels in under three seconds without requiring internet connectivity.
  The proposed system is built on a dual-branch EfficientNet-B0 architecture that independently processes skin and sclera images. Deep features are fused with handcrafted YCbCr color statistics to jointly perform four-class severity classification and continuous bilirubin regression. A key contribution is a synthetic jaundice generation method that simulates bilirubin-induced yellowing through controlled YCbCr channel modifications on normal neonatal skin images. This approach addresses data scarcity, particularly for severe jaundice cases and darker Indian skin tones (Fitzpatrick Types IV to VI). In addition, a skin-tone normalization module improves prediction consistency across diverse neonatal complexions.
  Experimental results demonstrate an overall classification accuracy of 91.8 percent, a clinical sensitivity of 93.5 percent, and a bilirubin mean absolute error of 1.4 mg/dL. After INT8 quantization and ONNX conversion, the model size is reduced to 8.3 MB while maintaining inference times below three seconds on standard Android devices. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first India-focused neonatal jaundice AI system that combines multimodal image fusion, skin-tone adaptation, synthetic data augmentation, and fully offline mobile deployment within a single framework.

AI.tldr: 本文提出NeoJaundice-AI，一个基于智能手机的双分支EfficientNet-B0新生儿黄疸筛查系统，通过皮肤和巩膜照片在无网络环境下3秒内预测胆红素水平，在印度人群上达到91.8%的分类准确率和1.4 mg/dL的胆红素MAE。
AI.motivation: 新生儿黄疸（高胆红素血症）是全球最常见的新生儿疾病之一，仅印度每年就有约1500万病例。早期检测至关重要，但标准诊断需要血液检测，在农村诊所实验室设施有限的情况下往往不可行。因此，需要一种无需网络、快速、非侵入式的智能筛查方案。
AI.method: 基于双分支EfficientNet-B0架构，独立处理皮肤和巩膜图像；深度特征与手工设计的YCbCr颜色统计特征融合，联合执行四类严重程度分类和连续胆红素回归；提出合成黄疸生成方法，通过受控的YCbCr通道修改模拟胆红素导致的黄染；加入肤色归一化模块以提升不同新生儿肤色的预测一致性；最终通过INT8量化和ONNX转换将模型压缩至8.3 MB。
AI.result: 总体分类准确率91.8%，临床灵敏度93.5%，胆红素平均绝对误差1.4 mg/dL。模型经INT8量化与ONNX转换后体积减小至8.3 MB，在标准Android设备上推理时间低于3秒。
AI.conclusion: 据作者所知，这是首个面向印度人群的新生儿黄疸AI系统，将多模态图像融合、肤色适应、合成数据增强和完全离线移动部署整合在单一框架中。
AI.abstract_zh: 新生儿黄疸（高胆红素血症）是全球最常见的新生儿疾病之一，仅印度每年就有约1500万病例。早期检测至关重要，但标准诊断需要血液检测，在农村诊所实验室设施有限的情况下往往不可行。本文提出NeoJaundice-AI，一个基于智能手机的筛查系统，通过拍摄婴儿皮肤和巩膜（眼白）的照片，在无需互联网连接的情况下于三秒内估计黄疸严重程度并预测血清胆红素水平。该系统的核心是一个双分支EfficientNet-B0架构，独立处理皮肤和巩膜图像。深度特征与手工设计的YCbCr颜色统计特征相融合，联合执行四类严重程度分类和连续胆红素回归。一项关键贡献是提出了一种合成黄疸生成方法，通过在正常新生儿皮肤图像上进行受控的YCbCr通道修改来模拟胆红素导致的黄染。该方法解决了数据稀缺问题，尤其是针对严重黄疸病例和较深的印度肤色（Fitzpatrick IV至VI型）。此外，肤色归一化模块提升了跨不同新生儿肤色的预测一致性。实验结果表明，总体分类准确率为91.8%，临床灵敏度为93.5%，胆红素平均绝对误差为1.4 mg/dL。经过INT8量化和ONNX转换后，模型大小缩减至8.3 MB，同时在标准Android设备上保持低于三秒的推理时间。据作者所知，这是首个面向印度人群的新生儿黄疸AI系统，将多模态图像融合、肤色适应、合成数据增强和完全离线移动部署整合在单一框架中。

title: Regular Perturbation on the Group-Velocity Dispersion Parameter for Dual-Polarization Short-Reach Systems
summary: The Manakov equation governs the propagation of signals in dual-polarization systems. Its solution is usually approximated by regular perturbation on the nonlinear Kerr parameter. In this paper, we propose a novel regular perturbation on the group-velocity dispersion parameter for the Manakov equation.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种针对Manakov方程的新摄动方法，将摄动参数从非线性Kerr系数改为群速度色散参数。
AI.motivation: 传统方法采用非线性Kerr参数进行正则摄动来近似求解Manakov方程，本文试图探索一种新的摄动途径。
AI.method: 对Manakov方程中的群速度色散参数进行正则摄动。
AI.result: 本文未在摘要中明确给出具体实验结果或分析结果。
AI.conclusion: 提出了一种以群速度色散参数为摄动量的新正则摄动方法，为Manakov方程的求解提供了新途径。
AI.abstract_zh: Manakov方程描述了信号在双偏振系统中的传播特性。通常，其解是通过对非线性Kerr参数进行正则摄动来近似得到的。本文提出了一种针对Manakov方程的新的正则摄动方法，该方法以群速度色散参数作为摄动量。

title: SPIDER -- Stitched Power-spectra for Inferring Directed information flow from incomplete and asynchronous Experimental Recordings
summary: Mapping the directed flow of information between brain regions -- their effective connectivity -- is central to understanding brain function, yet large-scale recordings sample only a fraction of the brain at a time: sessions, animals, and laboratories cover different, partially overlapping regions, usually without a shared temporal reference. Established directed-connectivity methods (Granger causality, dynamic causal modeling, partial directed coherence, PDC) require all regions to be recorded simultaneously and with a common clock. We introduce SPIDER, a non-parametric, frequency-domain framework that recovers directed information flow from such incomplete, asynchronous recordings: it stitches local power-spectral estimates from overlapping channel subsets into a global spectral matrix and obtains frequency-resolved directed interactions by canonical spectral factorization and PDC, without temporal alignment, while nuclear-norm completion fills in never-co-observed region pairs. With consistency guarantees, we validate SPIDER on simulations, two-photon calcium imaging, and the International Brain Laboratory Neuropixels dataset, recovering directed flow among 50 areas from 43 sessions in 12 laboratories never recorded together. Beyond validation, SPIDER reveals what no single recording can: brain-wide spontaneous flow is largely recurrent, but in the theta band it forms a significant feedforward hierarchy with the hippocampal formation at its source. Applied to resting human intracranial EEG (43 patients, non-overlapping coverage), it recovers the same theta-band hierarchy across species and modality. SPIDER makes whole-brain effective-connectivity analysis tractable for multi-session, multi-animal datasets previously incompatible with directed-flow inference.

AI.tldr: SPIDER是一种非参数频域框架，能够从不完整、异步记录的多区域脑活动数据中恢复有效连接（有向信息流），无需时间对齐，并通过核范数补全处理从未同时观测的区域对。在仿真、双光子钙成像和IBL神经像素数据集上验证，成功从12个实验室43个会话中恢复50个脑区间的有向流，揭示了theta频段的海马-皮层前馈层级结构，并跨物种推广到人类颅内脑电数据。
AI.motivation: 传统有向连接方法（如格兰杰因果、动态因果模型、偏定向相干PDC）要求所有脑区同时记录且共享同一时钟，但大规模记录往往只能覆盖部分脑区，不同会话、动物和实验室覆盖不同且部分重叠的区域，缺乏共同时间参考，这使得全脑有效连接分析在现有数据上不可行。
AI.method: SPIDER框架：1）从重叠信道子集中提取局部功率谱估计；2）通过核范数补全填补从未同时观测的区域对；3）将局部谱拼接为全局谱矩阵；4）通过规范谱分解和偏定向相干（PDC）获得频率分辨的有向交互，无需时间对齐。
AI.result: 在仿真、双光子钙成像和IBL神经像素数据集上验证，成功从12个实验室43个会话中恢复50个脑区间的有向信息流；发现全脑自发活动流多为循环结构，但在theta频段形成显著的前馈层级，海马结构为源头；在人类静息态颅内脑电（43名患者，非重叠覆盖）上复现了跨物种和模态的theta频段层级结构。
AI.conclusion: SPIDER使基于多会话、多动物数据集的、此前与有向流推断不兼容的全脑有效连接分析变得可行，为整合分散记录数据（不同实验室、不同动物、不同会话）以推断脑区间定向信息流提供了通用框架。
AI.abstract_zh: 绘制脑区之间有向信息流的映射——即它们的有效连接——是理解脑功能的核心，然而大规模记录每次只能采样大脑的一小部分：不同的会话、动物和实验室覆盖了不同且部分重叠的区域，通常缺乏共同的时间参考。现有的有向连接方法（格兰杰因果、动态因果模型、偏定向相干PDC）要求所有区域同时记录且共享同一时钟。我们提出SPIDER，一个非参数频域框架，能从这种不完整、异步的记录中恢复有向信息流：它将来自重叠信道子集的局部功率谱估计拼接成全局谱矩阵，并通过规范谱分解和偏定向相干（PDC）获得频率分辨的有向交互，无需时间对齐，同时利用核范数补全填补从未同时观测的区域对。在一致性保证下，我们在仿真、双光子钙成像和国际脑实验室Neuropixels数据集上验证了SPIDER，从12个实验室43个从未同时记录的会话中恢复了50个脑区间的有向流。除验证外，SPIDER揭示了单一记录无法获得的内容：全脑自发活动流很大程度上是循环的，但在theta频段形成了显著的前馈层级结构，海马结构为其源头。应用于人类静息态颅内脑电图（43名患者，非重叠覆盖），它跨物种和模态恢复了相同的theta频段层级结构。SPIDER使全脑有效连接分析对于此前与有向流推断不兼容的多会话、多动物数据集变得可行。

title: ELADO: Elliptic PDE Assessment Datasets for Operator Learning
summary: We introduce ELADO (Elliptic PDE Assessment Datasets for Operator Learning), a systematic benchmark suite constructed to show and quantify failure modes of neural operator architectures when learning solution operators of elliptic PDEs. While the benchmarks of existing datasets focus on average case performance, the ELADO datasets are constructed to highlight challenges that arise naturally in elliptic PDE problems. In particular, we construct several datasets built around Poisson's equation and the Helmholtz equation, each with non-constant coefficients.
